jd.text:
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
Your Mission:
We're looking for a Senior Product Analytics Manager to lead analytics for the Business Account Squad at Wise.
You’ll lead a team of 5+ analysts who are embedded in the product teams that are building the primary account businesses use for their banking needs - globally!
The Business Account Squad sits at the heart of our proposition for businesses, building solutions to ensure that businesses can successfully and safely start to use Wise; empowering them with the workflows and controls needed to run their finances globally with ease!
Robust analytical leadership is critical to ensure we proactively leverage data to shape our roadmap and drive high-impact initiatives, ensuring that every product decision makes moving money faster, cheaper, and easier for everyone, everywhere.
This is an AL2 role. For more information on our Analytics Career Map and levelling structure, click here .
What you’ll be doing:
Partner with Product/Engineering/Design leads to identify opportunities to improve our product and bring them to life; review team plans and progress, giving them effective feedback.
Create and communicate a clear picture of progress against product goals. Ensure that we have clear goals, measurable KPIs, narrate our progress and drive action to accelerate progress.
Own the data strategy for Business Account Analytics: define the roadmap to build the data and tools necessary to scale impact. Increase the speed and effectiveness of decision making across the squad.
Lead, develop and support a team of high performing analysts. Support analyst professional development via performance feedback & coaching; hire and plan capacity and ensure that analyst efforts maximise impact.
What you’ll bring:
5-6 years experience as an analyst and 2-5 years leading others (can be overlapping)
You have experience working with product teams: identifying and evaluating opportunities that will maximise impact for customers and KPI progress; evaluating the impact of what you shipped; recommending changes and new initiatives.
Analytical thinker with strong analysis skills (SQL, Python), data modelling (e.g. Airflow, dbt) and experience using event data (e.g. Mixpanel).
Bias to action: you identify what needs to be done and make it happen.
You can work independently in a fast-paced environment (able to identify impactful projects and evaluate & triage inbound requests).
Strong stakeholder management skills - you are collaborative, you know how to influence and when to say yes or no to maximise impact.
B2B experience and familiarity with business financial workflows are preferred, but not required.
What do we offer:
Salary: £105,000 - £150,000
Company Restricted Stock Units
Numerous great benefits in our London office
Key benefits:
Hybrid working
Paid annual holiday, sick days, parental leave and other leave opportunities
6 weeks of paid sabbatical after 4 years at Wise on top of annual leave
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs .
Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram .

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.
Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.
More about our mission and what we offer .
Wise Business has historically grown through self-serve and product-led channels. We’re now building a dedicated velocity sales team to help larger businesses discover, adopt, and fully activate on Wise for their international payment and banking needs. We’re looking for an experienced Salesforce & GTM Systems Specialist, who is passionate about the Wise mission – money without borders – to join our GTM Systems team. This is a key role in driving performance by collaborating with commercial leadership, revenue operations, analytics, marketing and other cross-function teams to ensure the execution of our Go-To-Market strategies. This will be a high impact and visibility role. The role is based in our London office, but you will also work closely with the global Wise Business Sales teams.
Since 2011, we’ve had a clear mission: money without borders. Built by and for people who live global lives, we’re the fairest, easiest way to manage your money across borders.
Over 10 million active personal and 700,000 business customers now use Wise to move more than £25 billion across borders each quarter, and saved £1.5 billion compared to banks over the past year.
A bit about the role:
In this role you will be responsible for designing and building the systems that power the Wise Business go-to-market engine. You will utilise your Salesforce expertise alongside other key tools across marketing, enrichment and engagement to build and optimize processes for our commercial teams for this high velocity business. You will work cross functionally to partner with Sales Leadership, Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement & Marketing to translate their needs into scalable systems and workflows that accelerate and streamline a fast growing area of the business. You will lead tooling for the newly setup Wise Business Sales teams and should be excited about the 0-1 build phase. You must be self-driven, motivated and comfortable with ambiguity. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Salesforce and systems that goes beyond administration within a high growth environment, preferably in the fintech space.
Your mission:
Own the Wise Business area within the GTM Systems team - Contribute to scaling, supporting growth and driving success of the function through enablement of tooling and processes that you will build.
Design, build and maintain Salesforce solutions, from complex flows to custom objects and third-party integrations.
Design, build and iterate from the ground up towards a world class sales process - that streamlines Lead Intake, Scoring, Routing and Qualification utilising Salesforce and GTM Systems.
Work cross functionally with key stakeholders across Sales, RevOps, Sales Enablement, Marketing and Analytics to identify key pain points and initiatives. Refining these into a prioritisation to focus on delivering what will bring the most impact.
Lead complex cross-functional initiatives end to end, from technical scoping through build, deployment and rollout.
Proactively identify areas of opportunity to improve our processes, whether using Salesforce solutions and features, leveraging our existing GTM Systems or looking for new vendors we should partner with.
Contribute internally to team planning, strategy and team processes to accelerate our own capabilities.
A bit about you:
You have strong experience with GTM Systems: 5+ years working across GTM Systems in a high growth and high velocity deal environment.
You have a lot of hands-on Salesforce experience:
8+ years of Salesforce experience - Expertise beyond administration.
You've led complex cross-functional builds end to end, from scoping through build.
You have demonstrable experience in data modelling, building complex flows in flow builder, Salesforce integration with internal/third party systems.
Certifications are preferable, but we’re looking for hands-on experience within a business.
You enjoy problem solving - By nature you are a problem solver - you don’t need to know the answer to every question, but can be presented with a business issue and take this away to formulate a scalable solutions to solve it.
You are technically minded - Working with technology, systems, tools is something that gives you energy. You stay up to date naturally on latest developments in tech across Salesforce, AI and related technologies.
You are a strong communicator - You have strong communication skills, stakeholder management and enjoy working with non technical stakeholders to translate their needs into solutions.
High Growth environment - You have previously worked in a high growth environment (startup and/or scaleup) in a build phase and are comfortable with ambiguity.
You have experience working across multi systems - You have experience working across the whole GTM stack to build seamless, integrated data surfacing processes:
Salesforce - Sales Cloud
Marketing - HubSpot, Marketing Cloud (Pardot), Braze
Revenue Intelligence & Productivity - Weflow, Gong
Lead Enrichment - Cognism, ZoomInfo, Clay, Apollo
Lead Signal - 6sense, Demandbase, Clay
Sales Engagement - Salesloft, Apollo
Integration & Automation - Workato, Zapier, Mulesoft
Deployment - DevOps, Gearset, Copado
Admin tools - Data loader, Workbench, Spreadsheets, SF Inspector
AI - Slackbot, Agentforce, Gemini, Credal.ai, ChatGPT/Codex

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

As a Workplace Venue Specialist, you will own the operational delivery and logistics for events across our on-site spaces. Acting as the operational “conductor” of our venues, you’ll ensure rooms are booked accurately, configured safely to specifics, supported with the right AV and services, and reset to a high standard. Reporting directly to the Workplace Operations Manager within the Workplace team, you’ll also collaborate on broader team initiatives to deliver a world-class experience for our Wisers and contribute to key workplace projects.
You’ll support 10+ events per week on average across two primary event spaces:
Event Space A: 200+ pax capacity, auditorium style
Event Space B: 145 pax capacity event space, with flexibility to divide into three separate areas, 30–50 pax capacity each
In addition to:
Training room: 45 pax Capacity
Meeting room booking support & logistics
Key responsibilities
Venue Scheduling, Allocation & Calendar Governance Act as the primary operational owner for on-site event space bookings, configuration logic, and venue availability across all office spaces.
Own the master venue calendar—applying clear judgment and prioritization rules to resolve complex booking conflicts independently and transparently.
Evaluate event briefs and advise organizers on optimal room sizes, split-room layouts, and capacity limits, recommending usage guidelines to ensure safety and ideal space utilization.
Ensure end-to-end operational briefs (layout, AV specs, access/security, catering/drinks, timing, and cleaning reset) are fully captured and vetted prior to event approval.
Monitor booking data and space usage trends to identify operational bottlenecks. Own, refine and redefine the event support helpdesk system—continuously optimizing request workflows, tracking service SLAs, and driving process improvements to streamline how Wisers request event space support.
Event logistics delivery (Workplace scope) Translate multi-layered organizer requirements into actionable, on-site execution plans (turnaround timelines, wayfinding, space layouts, and operational supplies).
Coordinate independently with IT/AV, Security, Facilities, and external catering vendors—aligning timelines, setting service expectations, and handling live escalations seamlessly.
Exercise real-time judgment during live events to resolve unexpected operational or tech hiccups, ensuring zero impact on the attendee experience.
Design, maintain, and continuously refine operational playbooks and checklists for recurring event formats to drive consistent delivery standards across the team.
On-site team leadership (Porter team) Line manages the porter team, ensuring clear daily/weekly planning, task allocation, and coverage for peaks (including early/late support when needed).
Train and coach the team on safe set-ups, customer service expectations, space standards, and consistent execution.
Plan for scaling the team based on business needs as the new building opens: workflow design, role clarity, and readiness standards.
Manage the vendor and relationship directly with the business partner.
Stakeholder management & service clarity Partner effectively with Wiser organisers while maintaining clear boundaries of responsibility (Workplace logistics vs organiser-owned content/comms).
Coordinate with Security for external attendee access requirements and on-site procedures.
Coordinate with the cleaning vendor and Facilities Supervisor to ensure spaces are event-ready and reset to “business-as-usual” standards post-event.
Communicate proactively when requirements are unclear, lead times are insufficient, or plans introduce risk (capacity, safety, timings, access).
Standards, safety & continuous improvement Ensure compliance with health & safety, fire regulations, and capacity limits, including split-room configurations and egress planning.
Own venue operational standards: cleanliness expectations, room condition, furniture/equipment readiness, and storage discipline.
Track operational issues and implement improvements (e.g., turnaround times, common AV problems, recurring organiser gaps, vendor reliability).
We're looking for people with experience in venue operations, workplace/event logistics, hospitality operations, or facilities-adjacent event delivery in a fast-paced, busy environment with a high frequency of events.
Operational ownership: Comfortable running a busy weekly cadence, managing competing priorities, and delivering reliably with minimal day-to-day supervision.
On-site requirement: This role is on-site and involves regular movement across buildings/venues, as well as occasional hands-on support during space set-ups and resets.
People leadership: Experience managing front-line operational teams (e.g., porters, FOH, facilities, hospitality), including scheduling, coaching, and performance management.
Stakeholder judgement: Confident engaging with senior stakeholders and organisers, making pragmatic calls under pressure, and setting clear service boundaries.
Tech & AV coordination: Able to coordinate with AV team for readiness and troubleshoot basics; comfortable working with workplace tools and booking/workspace systems.
Mindset: Calm, detail-oriented, service-led, and solutions-focused—able to recover quickly from last-minute changes.

Campaign Management and Optimisation
Manage and optimise paid search campaigns that support customer acquisition and efficiency goals.
Work across large-scale Google Ads, Microsoft Ads and Apple Ads accounts covering multiple markets and languages.
Monitor campaign performance, identify trends and recommend practical actions to improve results.
Support campaign launches and expansion into new markets, products and search or discovery channels.

Use search-term, campaign and customer-behaviour insights to improve the relevance and clarity of our advertising.
Work with colleagues across Marketing, Product and Analytics to help customers find the information and services most relevant to their needs.
Reporting and Analysis
Maintain and improve campaign reports and dashboards, ensuring performance is communicated clearly and accurately.
Analyse campaign data to identify optimisation opportunities, risks and areas requiring further investigation.
Support forecasting and campaign planning by providing reliable performance inputs and clearly explaining underlying assumptions.
Translate analysis into concise recommendations for both paid search colleagues and wider stakeholders.
Collaboration and Development
Work closely with Paid Search team members, sharing learnings and contributing to collaborative problem-solving.
Partner with teams including SEO, Product, Analytics and Paid Marketing on projects that improve acquisition and the wider customer journey.
Take ownership of assigned projects and campaign areas, communicating progress, risks and results clearly.
Contribute to team documentation, best-practice processes and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Proactively seek feedback and develop your technical, analytical and commercial paid search skills

Practical experience using Google Ads; experience with Microsoft Ads, Apple Ads or other performance marketing platforms is beneficial.
A sound understanding of campaign structure, keyword management, search terms, audience targeting, ad copy and automated bidding.
Confidence working with campaign data and using it to identify trends, diagnose performance changes and recommend next steps.
Familiarity with conversion tracking, attribution and core paid search measurement principles. ●
Experience using spreadsheets and reporting or visualisation tools to analyse and communicate performance.
An interest in automation, generative AI and the ways new technologies are changing search marketing.
Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns or tasks while maintaining accuracy.
Clear communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues from different disciplines.
A proactive and customer-focused mindset, with a willingness to take ownership, learn and test new approaches.
An understanding of how paid search contributes to the broader customer journey and works alongside channels such as SEO, Paid Social and Affiliates.

At Wise, we’re on a mission to empower people and businesses to make smarter, more transparent financial decisions. We operate as a collective of autonomous teams, trusting and empowering everyone to take ownership and execute on the things that drive the greatest impact for our customers. The search landscape is evolving rapidly, driven by generative AI, machine learning and changing customer discovery behaviours. We’re looking for a data-driven Paid Search Senior Executive to help us acquire net-new customers for Wise Business across multiple platforms, markets and languages. Your focus will be exclusively on B2B acquisition: helping new businesses and business owners discover Wise and sign up for a Wise Business account. You’ll bring at least 1–2 years of hands-on paid search experience and should be comfortable working with campaign data, identifying opportunities and turning insights into action. Experience in B2B or business-customer acquisition is highly preferred, alongside an understanding of how business needs, decision-making and conversion journeys can differ from those of personal customers. Working closely with other Paid Search specialists and cross-functional partners, you’ll contribute to the growth of Wise Business while developing your skills in managing increasingly complex, global campaigns.
Campaign Management and Optimisation
Manage and optimise paid search campaigns focused on acquiring net-new Wise Business customers and driving efficient business account sign-ups.
Work across large-scale Google Ads and Microsoft Ads accounts covering multiple markets, languages and business customer segments.
Monitor campaign performance, identify trends and recommend practical actions to increase sign-ups and improve acquisition efficiency.
Use keyword, search-term and audience insights to identify high-intent business customers and improve campaign relevance.
Support campaign launches and expansion into new markets, business segments and search or discovery channels.
Carry out regular account maintenance, quality assurance and performance checks to ensure campaigns are accurate and operating as intended.
AI and Automation
Use platform automation and AI-powered features, such as automated bidding, Performance Max and AI Max, to improve B2B campaign performance and operational efficiency.
Identify opportunities to make recurring campaign-management and reporting processes more efficient through automation, templates or improved ways of working.
Stay informed about developments in search marketing, generative AI and the ways business customers discover and evaluate financial services.
Testing and the Business Customer Experience
Support the end-to-end delivery of structured tests across ad copy, assets, targeting, bidding and landing pages.
Develop clear hypotheses, monitor results and turn findings into actionable recommendations for business customer acquisition.
Test messaging that responds to the different needs, challenges and motivations of businesses and business owners.
Use search-term, campaign and customer-behaviour insights to improve the relevance and clarity of Wise Business advertising.
Work with colleagues across Marketing, Wise Business, Product and Analytics to help prospective business customers find the information and services most relevant to their needs.
Reporting and Analysis
Maintain and improve campaign reports and dashboards, ensuring B2B acquisition performance is communicated clearly and accurately.
Analyse campaign data to identify optimisation opportunities, emerging business-customer segments, risks and areas requiring further investigation.
Track performance against relevant acquisition outcomes, including Wise Business account sign-ups and acquisition-efficiency targets.
Break down performance by market, campaign, audience, search intent and other relevant dimensions to understand what is driving results.
Support forecasting and campaign planning by providing reliable performance inputs and clearly explaining underlying assumptions.
Translate analysis into concise recommendations for both Paid Search colleagues and wider Wise Business stakeholders.
Collaboration and Development
Work closely with Paid Search team members, sharing B2B acquisition learnings and contributing to collaborative problem-solving
Partner with teams including Wise Business, SEO, Product, Analytics and Paid Marketing on projects that improve business customer acquisition and the wider sign-up journey.
Take ownership of assigned projects and campaign areas, communicating progress, risks and results clearly.
Develop an understanding of Wise Business customers, their financial needs and the factors that influence their choice of provider.
Contribute to team documentation, best-practice processes and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Proactively seek feedback and develop your technical, analytical and commercial paid search skills.
You have 1–2+ years of experience running direct-response paid search campaigns for a fast-growing business or agency
Experience acquiring B2B customers or working with business-focused products is highly preferred.
You have practical experience using Google Ads; experience with Microsoft Ads or other performance marketing platforms is beneficial.
You have a sound understanding of campaign structure, keyword management, search terms, audience targeting, ad copy and automated bidding.
You’re confident working with campaign data and using it to identify trends, diagnose performance changes and recommend next steps.
You understand conversion tracking, attribution and the core measurement principles behind acquisition campaigns.
You’re interested in understanding the different needs, search behaviours and decision-making journeys of businesses and business owners.

As Lead Design Researcher for the Verification Experience squad, you’ll combine hands-on research with people leadership and squad-level strategic direction. You’ll set research priorities, lead and develop researchers, and ensure evidence is focused on the most important customer and business problems.
You’ll remain close to the craft and personally lead projects, particularly when the work is highly strategic, ambiguous or requires research leadership. At the same time, you’ll create the conditions for your direct reports to do their best work, giving them clear direction, thoughtful coaching and the right level of challenge.
You’ll bring together qualitative, quantitative and mixed-methods evidence to shape both customer-facing verification experiences and the internal tools that help our teams solve problems efficiently.
At Lead level, success isn’t measured only by the research you deliver yourself. It’s measured by the quality and impact of your team’s work, the growth and performance of your direct reports, and the clarity of direction you create across Verification.
Here’s how you’ll make an impact:
Setting priorities and research direction — Set clear priorities for yourself and your direct reports, connecting the team’s work to squad and business goals.
Shaping strategy — Turn research into clear opportunities that influence the focus, priorities and product direction of the Verification squad.
Articulating now, next and future — Help teams understand what they need to learn today, what comes next and how their decisions contribute to the longer-term Verification experience.
Leading through people — Set clear expectations, support the growth of your direct reports and take responsibility for their performance and impact, course-correcting when needed.
Staying close to the craft — Personally lead strategic or complex research projects while raising research quality, thinking and technical capability across the team and squad.
Influencing stakeholders — Build strong relationships and skilfully navigate conversations with teams, squads and senior leaders to create alignment and champion customer-centred decisions.
Leading with guts — Set ambitious goals, address difficult problems and confidently champion quality, our customers and a human-centred approach.
Using tools thoughtfully — Help your team use AI and emerging tools where they improve speed, quality or impact while maintaining research rigour and sound judgement.
About you:
You have 6+ years of experience in product research, including managing researchers and supporting their growth, performance and progression.
You know how to bring out the best in people, setting clear expectations and providing thoughtful coaching and feedback.
You build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Engineering and Analytics to align priorities and get things done.
You connect customer evidence with business outcomes, turning research into clear opportunities that inspire action.
You’re empathetic and consistently keep customers’ needs at the heart of decisions.
You have a strong track record of growing research influence across product teams and with senior stakeholders.
You can shape research and product direction across a squad while championing quality and human-centred design.
For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

Come parte del team Claims di Zurich Italia , la persona che stiamo cercando entrerà nella funzione Claims Services, con il compito di gestire le attività della nostra Authority interna.
Cosa farai
Ti occuperai dell’elaborazione delle stime danni e della trattazione del danno, prevalentemente con le carrozzerie del network convenzionato, su base documentale;
Seguirai tutte le azioni propedeutiche al pagamento e alla chiusura degli incarichi concordati;
Gestirai i reclami;
Effettuerai audit sulla rete peritale;
Condurrai analisi qualitative dell’attività e suggerirai azioni migliorative per aumentare efficienza ed efficacia del servizio;
Ti dedicherai all’analisi quantitativa dell’andamento dell’attività.
Sei la persona giusta se hai
L’abilitazione a svolgere incarichi come professionista della perizia Auto;
L’iscrizione al ruolo dei professionisti della perizia Auto assicurativa;
Un’ottima conoscenza dei principali software peritali;
Almeno 3 anni di esperienza presso studi peritali strutturati o in ruoli simili in compagnie assicurative;
Ottime capacità relazionali e di negoziazione;
Dimestichezza con gli strumenti informatici di produttività individuale (MS Office, Word, Excel, Outlook, …);
Capacità e desiderio di individuare modalità per migliorare la tua attività quotidiana e i risultati del tuo lavoro;
Attitudine a lavorare per obiettivi;

Data Center Engineering Operations Senior Technician - AWS Owned DC, DCEO

Description
The Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) team is seeking engineers who can deploy, operate, and maintain the facilities (electrical/mechanical systems, control/fire-fighting systems, etc.) and manage related projects at our large-scale, high-density data centers.
As a member of this gender and culturally diverse team, you will have a chance to work with exciting technology in a dynamic environment with expanding opportunities.
The role requires a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to complex technical problems. This is a Mechanical and Electrical (M&E) engineering role, managing infrastructure such as diesel generators, switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, fire detection systems and building automation systems. You will report to the Data Center Engineering Operations Facilities Manager.
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
SAFETY
Follow and maintain the highest safety standards and diligently encourage a world-class safety culture. As a facility owner team member, ensure remediation of safety risks/issues in conjunction with other teams. Own safety initiatives and projects to foster strong safety culture.
Lead by example in implementing and maintaining AWS safety protocols
Respond to emergency situations and coordinate with emergency services as needed
ENGINEERING & FACILITY OPERATIONS AND MAINTENANCE
Operational hands on experience, and deep knowledge with electrical, mechanical, fire protection and control systems, including Uninterruptable Power Supplies (UPS’s), Switchgear, Circuit Breakers, Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS's), Diesel Generators, Chillers, Heating Ventilation Air Conditioning (HVAC), Water treatment systems, Static Transfer Switch (STS), Exhaust Fans, Variable Frequency Drives (VFD's), Fire Systems and Transformers.
Operate, monitor, and maintain fire detection and suppression systems including pre-action systems, VESDA (Very Early Smoke Detection Apparatus), and other fire protection equipment
Draft, review and publish Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOP) and Method of Procedures (MOP) for in -house activities.
Review vendor documentation for preventative maintenance (e.g. RAMS – Risk Assessment Method of Statement)
Perform routine inspections and testing of fire alarm panels, smoke detectors, and suppression systems in accordance with AWS standards and local regulations
Troubleshoot and resolve straightforward electro-mechanical problems; and collaborates with the engineering team, within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA’s)
Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log-taking (temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.)
Perform hands-on preventive and corrective maintenance activities on critical infrastructure
Execute equipment repairs, replacements, and facility modifications in accordance with AWS standards guidelines.
Maintain accurate documentation of all maintenance activities, equipment performance, and system configurations
Collaborate with internal AWS teams on capacity planning and infrastructure improvements
Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance
Respond to alarms and perform emergency troubleshooting and repairs
Execute and plan work assignments, using maintenance and change management documents, and by reviewing outstanding action items with your Facility Manager and/or Chief Engineer.
Take action to make improvements based on operating experience, assist in the creation of process improvement plans, and provide process improvement feedback to site leadership
Manual handling and lifting of equipment may be required (weight limits in accordance with health & safety regulations)
SHIFT WORK
This is a shift-based position hence availability to work rotating shifts is required for this position.
The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector . The position is classified at level 6 or above, depending on the candidate’s skills, competences and experience.
A day in the life
Why AWS?
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500
companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Basic Qualifications
Speak, write, and read fluently in English
Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
Several years of hands-on experience with critical facility operations and maintenance
Professional or formal Electrical Certification or Apprentice/trades certified or diploma in an Electrical field
Demonstrate advanced electrical competencies (Practice & Theory) and strong knowledge of mechanical systems (Mechanical, HVAC systems, Controls)
Knowledge of fire detection and suppression systems
Driving license valid in Italy (required for shift-based schedule)
Preferred Qualifications
Experience leading cross-functional projects and implementing strategic initiatives
Data Center/mission critical engineering experience
Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS) and monitoring platforms
Hands-on experience with fire protection systems including pre-action, VESDA, and gaseous suppression systems
Experience performing direct maintenance and repairs on critical infrastructure equipment
Experience working in shift-based operations environments
Willing to travel between data center sites, and internationally if required
Demonstrated experience mentoring or training technical staff

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
Grade D/EB8.
We are looking for a Lead Product Owner to work at the forefront of our Affordability domain within our Consumer Information business. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone to work at the heart of one of Experian's main strategic areas.
The domain spans Open Banking, bureau-based affordability and screen-based credit risk products, and this is a dual role. Reporting into the Head of Product. You will lead and line manage the other Product Owners across the domain – setting the standard for how product ownership is done here, coaching the team, and raising the quality and pace of delivery across every squad.
We are looking for someone who leads by example: the person the other Product Owners learn from because of how they run their own team, not only because of what they say in a one-to-one.
Main Responsibilities
Domain Product Ownership
Own the total product backlog across the Affordability domain, ensuring it is current, well-shaped and delivered at pace.
Deliver against the domain product roadmap, prioritising work based on value, customer needs, compliance requirements and technical feasibility.
Contribute to the product strategy for the domain and ensure delivery stays aligned to it and to Experian's wider corporate goals.
Work with partners across departments to maintain a clear, shared view of the product and technology roadmap.
Act as an escalation point for product-related issues across the domain.
Product Owner for a Scrum Team
Drive the product vision and end-to-end backlog management for the dedicated Scrum team.
Translate requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team.
Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, review and retrospective ceremonies, upholding Agile principles and continuous improvement.
Make well-reasoned prioritisation decisions and keep the team unblocked.
Run this team as the reference example of good product ownership in the domain.
Lead and Coaching the Product Owner Team
Lead and line manage a team of Product Owners across the Affordability domain.
Set the standard for how the teams use AI in its daily product ownership, and coach Product Owners to adopt it well.
Coach Product Owners on backlog management, story writing, stakeholder engagement and prioritisation, adapting your support to each person's experience level.
Set clear, consistent standards for how product ownership is practised - definition of ready and done, story quality, acceptance criteria, roadmap and release communication.
Give direct, constructive feedback, and hold the team to the standards you set.
Support recruitment, onboarding, development plans, objective setting and performance conversations.
Build a collaborative team culture where Product Owners share problems and solutions across squads rather than working in isolation.
Delivery Performance & Ways of Working
Measure product and delivery performance using data-driven metrics, implementing improvements that maximise value and return on investment.
Identify and remove systemic friction across squads - dependencies, handovers, unclear ownership and inconsistent practice.
Work across time zones with development teams in the UK and India.
Promote iterative value drops, shipping frequent, meaningful increments.
Use AI tooling to work faster and better - accelerating discovery, requirement drafting, documentation and analysis
Support the wider AI-led transformation of our platform and ways of working, ensuring AI is applied responsibly and within our data governance and regulatory obligations.
Be driven by maximising the pace at which we deliver value to clients whilst never compromising on security.
Regulatory & Governance
Ensure regulatory compliance and data governance best practice across the product suite, including GDPR, Consumer Duty and FCA affordability expectations.
Work with compliance, legal and risk functions to ensure requirements are built in rather than retrofitted.
Ensure Open Banking products meet AISP permissions, consent and data use obligations.
Stakeholder Management & Domain Expertise
Communicate delivery status and product decisions to senior internal stakeholders.
Serve as a domain subject matter expert, staying current on industry trends, the competitive landscape and emerging technologies.
Represent the domain in cross-functional forums and support client-facing colleagues with product expertise where needed.
Substantial experience as a Product Owner in an Agile environment, with strong command of sprint ceremonies and backlog management. Experience leading, coaching or line managing other Product Owners or product professionals.
Experience in financial services or FinTech, ideally within lending, credit risk or affordability.
A track record of raising delivery quality and pace across more than one team.
Experience working with distributed or offshore development teams.
Analytical skills, and confidence using data to prioritise and to demonstrate value delivered.
Experience of a regulated environment and of working alongside compliance, legal and risk.
Experience of Open Banking, bureau data or credit risk decisioning products is highly advantageous.
Hybrid working, 2 days a week in our London office
Great compensation package and discretionary bonus
Core benefits include pension, bupa healthcare, sharesave scheme and more
25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can purchase additional annual leave.

records.title: Project Assistant | Forensic and Litigation Consulting

jd.text:
Who We Are
FTI Consulting is the leading global expert firm for organizations facing crisis and transformation. We work with many of the world’s top multinational corporations, law firms, banks and private equity firms on their most important issues to deliver impact that makes a difference. From resolving disputes, navigating crises, managing risk and optimizing performance, our teams respond rapidly to dynamic and complex situations.
At FTI Consulting, you’ll work side-by side with leaders who have shaped history, helping solve the biggest challenges making headlines today. From day one, you’ll be an integral part of a focused team where you can make a real impact. You’ll be surrounded by an open, collaborative culture that embraces diversity, recognition, professional development and, most importantly, you.
Are you ready to make your impact?
About The Role
The Forensic & Litigation Consulting segment is seeking a Project Assistant to support their teams, manage client processes and ensure the smooth functioning of projects. The candidate must be experienced in supporting senior management at a high level, be highly numerate, have good written skills, the ability to take initiative and prioritise multiple tasks.
The key focus of the role will be to manage and co-ordinate the administration of client processes so that project and billing arrangements are centralised, organised, timely and efficient. Whilst not requiring financial qualifications, the successful candidate will have experience and a keen interest in bringing rigour to project delivery processes including managing project set up from the initial sales lead and conflict checks to managing the full commercial life cycle of a project including cost and fee reconciliations including sub-contractor arrangements, invoicing and WIP management and ensuring efficient closing down of projects.
The role may involve occasional EA support to FLC team leadership as well as ad hoc cover of various processes, initiatives and internal projects as required.
Accuracy and attention to detail are essential. The nature of the business is driven by client deadlines and on occasion the successful candidate may be required to work outside the core hours at short notice. The role will be suited to someone who enjoys a full, varied and sometimes deadline-driven day. The successful candidate will be self-assured, flexible and reliable with a positive demeanour and a keen interest in the financial management of projects.
What You'll Do
Provide end to end client and project commercial management process support, overseeing the project life cycle, delivery assurance and best practice processes
Open client projects within our CRM system - following the internal set-up process from start to finish on a high volume of client projects, ensuring all project details are correct on internal systems according to the LoE
Update any project trackers as required
Ensure subcontractors are successfully and efficiently onboarded using the internal onboarding system, working closely with our Human Resources team to ensure subcontractor contracts are kept up to date and are in accordance with IR35
Manage subcontractor trackers and collate and process complex subcontractor invoices, ensuring invoices are processed in a timely manner
Financial reporting - including pulling client matter reports for the team, pulling WIP reports, project cost management and financial management.
Prepare in-flight status reporting for clients as required
Client billing - working closely with the team to draft and finalise monthly client invoices and manage sending these to clients alongside the central team
Continual follow-up with clients on invoice status until receipt of payment
Provide information for revenue rec colleagues and assist with troubleshooting
Liaise with finance re write-offs, reserves and provide commentary
Manage comms around AR internally and to clients
Manage project closure process
Provide occasional EA cover including taking meeting notes, diary management, time entry travel arrangements
Assist with internal processes, initiatives and projects as required.
Assist with new joiner training from the project financial management perspective and associated processes and systems
Assist with ad hoc requests
How You'll Grow
We are committed to investing and supporting you in your professional development and we have developed a range of programs focused on fostering leadership, growth and development opportunities. We aim to promote continuous learning and individual skills development through on-the-job learning, self-guided professional development courses and certifications. You'll be assigned a dedicated coach to mentor, guide and support you through regular coaching sessions and serve as an advocate for your professional growth.
As you progress through your career at FTI Consulting, we offer tailored programs for critical professional milestones to ensure you are prepared and empowered to take on your next role.
What You Will Need To Succeed
Experience of managing admin and finance processes through the life-cycle of projects:
Experience using CRM database Salesforce is desirable but not essential
Ability to prioritise workload and to deal with multiple parties and requests
Strong attention to detail with strong organisational skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Excel, Work, Outlook, PowerPoint) and have an aptitude for learning systems
Proven experience of supporting a busy team, preferably in a consulting or financial environment is highly desirable
Ability to communicate with tact and diplomacy, both verbally and in writing with all levels of the organisation
Ability to communicate on behalf of senior leaders both to internal and external parties
Ability to work under time pressure and be available as needed
Strong team player
Excellent interpersonal skills with proven ability to establish rapport with people at all levels
Ability to handle confidential issues with utmost sensitivity
Strong levels of discretion and integrity
Ability to pursue and find solutions when they may not be immediately visible or available
The candidate should have advanced Microsoft Office applications skills, numerate agility and excellent interpersonal and communications skills underpinned by a proactive and positive approach.

Junior Consultant - Governance, Risk & Compliance - Industrial Market
6 ott 2026
The chance to build a better future is right in front of you
Do Work That Matters - Il tuo ruolo e le tue responsabilità
Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse. KPMG Advisory offre servizi di consulenza alle imprese per affiancarle nella trasformazione del business model, nel miglioramento e nella digitalizzazione dei processi, nell’analisi e nella gestione dei rischi, nonché supporto nelle operazioni di finanza straordinaria.
In particolare, entrando a far parte del Team Governance, Risk and Compliance di Milano , sarai impegnata/o nella gestione dei processi di cambiamento aziendali; in particolare, insieme a colleghe e colleghi esperti, analizzerai i requisiti strategici utili a implementare le migliori soluzioni presenti sul mercato.
Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:
Controllo interno e valutazione del rischio nel settore industriale;
Esecuzione di incarichi di conformità al Decreto Legislativo n . 231, SOX, 262 e anti-corruzione ;
Conformità integrata;
Audit interno ;
Valutazione e progettazione di sistemi di controllo interno ;
Studio della legislazione del settore industriale e delle sue applicazioni e implicazioni su processi e procedure;
Sviluppo di modelli di governance e organizzativi a supporto del processo di trasformazione aziendale.
Come As You Are - Le tue competenze e caratteristiche
Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:
Hai una laurea magistrale in economia e management, amministrazione aziendale e amministrazione, finanza e controllo;
Hai interesse a lavorare su temi di rischio e governance aziendale;
Hai un’ottima conoscenza dell’inglese, preferibilmente con esperienze di studio e/o lavoro all’estero;
Hai un’ottima conoscenza di Microsoft Office.
Your Future With Us - Cosa troverai in KPMG
Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo , equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le diversità;
Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la creatività e il lavoro di squadra;
Modalità di lavoro ibrida, per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale;
Programmi di formazione e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati;
Mindset internazionale e progettualità innovative;
Iniziative incentrate sul benessere psicofisico.
L’opportunità prevede un inserimento in stage con indennità mensile di 800€ per stage curriculare o 1.000€ per stage extracurriculare o in assunzione con inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio e RAL di ingresso: € 30.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi quali il titolo di studio e la valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.
In ottemperanza alla normativa vigente, non raccogliamo né utilizziamo informazioni sulle retribuzioni percepite in rapporti di lavoro attuali o precedenti. Le nostre procedure di selezione sono, inoltre, improntate a criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere.
Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno
Leadership, lavoro in team, rispetto di ogni individualità, approfondimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità, integrità: questi sono i Valori di KPMG che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e di conoscenza, che permette ai nostri professionisti di esprimere tutto il loro potenziale .Grazie all’impegno nel favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo , il nostro Network risulta conforme agli standard dei requisiti ISO 30415 , sul Sistema di Gestione per la Diversità e l’Inclusione, e UNI PdR 125 , relativa alla parità di genere. All’interno del nostro Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - trovi riassunte tutte le azioni concrete che stiamo portando avanti su tematiche ambientali, sociali e di governance ( ESG ).
Unisciti a noi!
I tuoi dati saranno trattati nel pieno rispetto delle disposizioni del Regolamento (UE) n. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - "GDPR") e successive modifiche. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare l'informativa sulla privacy di KPMG .
KPMG Advisory S.p.A. garantisce le pari opportunità.
The chance to build a better future is right in front of you
Do Work That Matters - Your role and responsibilities
Do you want to pursue a profession that is truly meaningful and impactful? At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, the company, and colleagues address and solve the most current and complex challenges. KPMG Advisory offers consulting services to companies to assist them in business model transformation, process improvement and digitisation, risk analysis and management, and support in extraordinary finance transactions. When you join the Governance, Risk and Compliance team, you will help companies transform risks into opportunities for the improvement of their organisation and evolution of their governance systems to gain a competitive edge and offer integrated solutions and innovative approaches for strategic risk management.
As a member of our team, your experience will be put to full use, enabling you to become the point person for top-tier national and international clients. We are recruiting a junior consultant for the Milan office to work on the following projects:
Internal control and risk assessment in the industrial sector;
Performance of Legislative decree no. 231, SOX, 262 and anti-bribery compliance engagements;
Integrated compliance ;
Internal auditing ;
Evaluating and designing internal control systems ;
Studying industrial sector legislation and its applications and implications on processes and procedures;
Development of governance and organizational models to support the corporate transformation process.
Come As You Are - Your skills and characteristics
This is the perfect opportunity for you if:
You have a master’s degree in business and management , business administration and administration, finance and controlling ;
You are interested in working on corporate governance ;
You have excellent knowledge of English , preferably with study and/or work experience abroad;
You have excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office.
In today’s increasingly complex and interconnected world, clients need to transform and adapt ever more rapidly. The successful candidate will be highly goal-driven and have an aptitude for problem solving, along with strong communication and interpersonal skills, a client focus, enthusiasm and strong career-orientation and a natural ability to work in a team and drive innovation.
Your Future With Us - What you’ll find at KPMG
An inclusive and equitable work environment that respects, encourages and values diversity.
A challenging and dynamic environment that encourages creativity and teamwork.
Hybrid work arrangements to promote a healthy work-life balance.
Advanced training and development programmes to stay current.
International mindset and innovative projects.
Initiatives focused on mental and physical well-being.
This opportunity is offered as either a paid internship offering a monthly allowance of €800 for curricular internships and €1,000 for extracurricular internships or a standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a starting gross annual salary of €30,000. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including educational qualifications and an assessment of the candidate’s profile against the requirements of the role.
In accordance with applicable legislation, we do not collect or use information relating to remuneration received in current or previous employment. Our selection procedures are based on objective and gender-neutral criteria.
Together for Better – Our values and commitment
Leadership, teamwork, respect every individual, continuous learning, transparency, commitment to the community and integrity. These are the KPMG values that create an environment that encourages the sharing of ideas and knowledge, so our professionals can achieve their full potential .
As a result of our commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment, our Network complies with the standards of the ISO 30415 requirements, on the Diversity and Inclusion Management System, and UNI PdR 125 , relating to gender equality. Within our Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - you will find summarised all the concrete actions we are taking on environmental, social and governance (ESG) issues.
Join us!
Your data will be processed in full compliance with the provisions of Regulation (EU) no. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - “GDPR”), as amended. For more information, please see KPMG’s privacy policy.
KPMG Advisory S.p.A. is an equal opportunity employer.

Job Category
Customer Success
Job Details
About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
We are seeking an experienced Director of Project Management to lead the successful delivery of complex digital transformation projects within major Product, Automotive, Consumer & Energy programmes.
The successful candidate will be responsible for leading large, strategically important projects from mobilisation through to successful implementation, ensuring delivery to agreed scope, schedule, budget and quality. Working alongside senior programme leadership, solution architects, delivery managers and customer executives, this role will provide strong delivery leadership across complex multi-disciplinary teams.
This is a senior client-facing role requiring exceptional leadership, governance and delivery management experience with a proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale technology-enabled transformation programmes.
Key Responsibilities
Project Leadership
Lead the delivery of large, complex projects that form part of wider enterprise transformation programmes.
Take end-to-end accountability for successful project delivery including scope, schedule, budget, quality and customer satisfaction.
Lead cross-functional delivery teams consisting of project managers, business analysts, architects, developers, testers, change specialists and partner organisations.
Create an environment that promotes collaboration, accountability and delivery excellence.
Delivery Management
Develop and maintain integrated project plans aligned to wider programme milestones and dependencies.
Drive predictable delivery through effective planning, estimation, resource management and governance.
Ensure projects are delivered using recognised project management methodologies, governance frameworks and delivery best practices.
Manage multiple workstreams and interdependencies across internal teams, customers and third-party suppliers.
Customer Engagement
Build trusted relationships with customer delivery leadership and senior business stakeholders.
Act as the primary delivery contact for assigned projects, providing clear communication, transparency and confidence throughout delivery.
Facilitate steering committees, project boards and governance forums.
Work collaboratively with customer teams to resolve delivery challenges and maintain programme momentum.
Governance, Risk & Assurance
Establish effective governance and reporting across all project activities.
Proactively identify and manage risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies (RAID), ensuring timely resolution and appropriate escalation.
Produce high-quality executive reporting covering delivery status, milestones, financial performance, risks and overall project health.
Ensure compliance with contractual obligations, quality standards and organisational delivery methodologies.
Commercial & Financial Management
Manage project financial performance, forecasting and budget control.
Monitor resource utilisation and delivery performance to ensure successful commercial outcomes.
Support change control processes, managing project scope while maintaining strong customer relationships.
Contribute to programme forecasting, planning and commercial reporting.
Leadership
Lead, coach and motivate high-performing project delivery teams.
Support the development of Project Managers and Delivery Managers through mentoring and coaching.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration and customer success.
Promote delivery excellence and the adoption of best practice across the wider delivery organisation.
Required Experience
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
Significant experience delivering complex technology-enabled transformation projects within Product, Automotive, Consumer &/or Energy industries.
Proven experience managing large-scale software implementation or digital transformation projects with multiple delivery teams and suppliers.
Experience leading projects involving 30–100+ delivery professionals across business and technology disciplines.
Strong experience managing project governance, financials, planning, RAID management and executive reporting.
Excellent stakeholder management skills with experience engaging senior customer leadership.
Experience managing complex delivery dependencies across multiple projects and workstreams.
Strong commercial awareness with experience managing budgets, forecasting and change control.
Outstanding communication, leadership and organisational skills.
Desirable Experience
Experience delivering Salesforce implementations or other enterprise cloud platform transformations.
Experience working within a major consulting organisation or systems integrator.
Familiarity with agile delivery methodologies and hybrid delivery models.
Experience working across multi-supplier delivery environments.
Knowledge of enterprise CRM, case management or customer service transformation programmes.
Qualifications
Degree or equivalent professional experience.
PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, AgilePM or equivalent project management qualification.
Scrum Master or SAFe certification desirable.
Personal Attributes
Strong delivery focus with exceptional attention to detail.
Calm, resilient and effective in complex delivery environments.
Excellent relationship builder with strong influencing skills.
Commercially aware with a customer-first mindset.
Collaborative leader who inspires confidence across customers, partners and delivery teams.
Unleash Your Potential
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

You can write clear requirements and user stories, and you're comfortable with senior executives, including sharing bad news early along with a plan to fix it.
Experience will be evaluated based on alignment to the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer work, etc.)

You know the Salesforce platform, including its APIs and platform services.

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
As a Principal AI Architect (or AI and Data Technical Architect), you will act as a senior, hands-on technical leader and trusted advisor to our customers. You will be responsible for designing, validating, and operationalizing enterprise-grade data and AI architectures centered on Salesforce D360 and the Agentforce platform. This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, platform architecture, and applied AI, requiring you to guide customer Chief Data Officers and Enterprise Architects through emerging AI solutions. You will work side-by-side with Account Executives and Product teams to ensure customers realize the full value of the platform by designing scalable, secure solutions that integrate D360 into complex enterprise ecosystems—including hyperscalers, data lakes, and governance frameworks.
Responsibilities
Lead pre-sales technical design by analyzing customer needs and recommending solutions aligned with Agentforce capabilities and integration with external agent frameworks.
Shape best practices around generative AI, agent interoperability, prompt engineering, Data Cloud, and cross-platform integrations.
Collaborate with AEs and SEs to build hands-on prototypes and demos using Agentforce and integrated external agents.
Develop thought leadership content—demo templates, whitepapers, enablement sessions—focused on agent lifecycle, integration strategy, and technical effectiveness.
Act as a central technical knowledge resource, proactively addressing internal technical inquiries, facilitating deep technical enablement, and documenting best practices to empower specialist teams across the organization.
If you are naturally curious about AI and Data, love diving into new technologies, and enjoy educating others while crafting solutions that deliver real business impact, we want to talk to you!
Understand Agent Interoperability - Map and integrate external agents from hyperscalers (e.g. Copilot, Gemini) into Agentforce via open standards (MCP, A2A); design how these systems collaborate.
Enable Conversational & Background Agents - Use Agentforce Studio and Agent Builder to configure chat and background agents; integrate with external channels including voice via hyperscaler APIs.
Drive Prompt Engineering & Lifecycle Strategy - Lead prompt design, testing, monitoring, and iteration; define agent lifecycle best practices from development through refinement.
Build Hands-On Demos & Prototypes - Co-create quick prototypes (<2 weeks) with AEs demonstrating integration between Agentforce and external agents or services.
Lead Pre-Sales Workshops - Facilitate whiteboarding, deep-dive sessions, and quick enablement for customers and internal teams.

Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. About the role:
We are seeking a Portfolio Associate to join the OEGEN Funds Team, reporting to the Senior Portfolio Manager.
The role will work across OEGEN’s listed funds, semi-liquid strategies and private funds, supporting investments in renewable infrastructure and liquid investments.
You will support the Senior Portfolio Manager across the full fund-management cycle, including portfolio analysis, valuations, cash-flow forecasting, debt, FX, hedging, governance and investor reporting. You will also have a particular role in analysing allocations and underlying fund information across semi-liquid and liquid strategies, reviewing valuations and asset performance across private market investments, and supporting the Finance team with monthly NAV processes.
The role would suit someone with a strong finance, accounting or investment background who is analytical, organised and comfortable working across recurring processes and more judgement-led portfolio analysis. It offers the opportunity to develop broad fund-management experience across a varied set of OEGEN portfolios.
What You'll Do
Portfolio management: Support the Senior Portfolio Manager with the day-to-day management of assigned portfolios, including monitoring investments, asset performance, fund KPIs, distributions, commitments, liquidity and investor returns. You will work with Asset Management, Investment, Finance and other teams to understand issues and ensure that actions are followed through.
Valuations and financial modelling: Support monthly, quarterly and annual valuation processes, including updating and reviewing DCF, investment and fund models, analysing assumptions, preparing valuation bridges and sensitivities, and challenging outputs from internal teams, external valuers and underlying managers. You will prepare clear analysis for internal and external stakeholders.
Cash flow, debt and hedging: Support cash-flow forecasting and analysis across the portfolios, including distributions, capital calls, liquidity, recycling and commitments. You will also help monitor debt structures, refinancing activity, managing covenants, hedging and other financial arrangements relevant to the funds, working closely with Finance and Investment teams.
Allocation and underlying fund analysis: Support analysis of portfolio construction, asset allocation and investment exposures, including gathering and assessing information from underlying funds and managers. This will include helping to draw together performance and portfolio information from semi-liquid and liquid investments and turning it into useful fund-level analysis and reporting.
Investor reporting: Lead or coordinate inputs into high-quality investor reports, factsheets, customer board materials, investor meetings and due diligence responses. You will help explain asset and portfolio performance, allocation, valuation movements, distributions, risks and outlook clearly and accurately for investors across the different fund types.
Private fund NAV and reporting: Work with the Finance team to support monthly NAV processes for underlying private funds, including checking underlying information, reconciling movements and maintaining clear supporting evidence. You will also help oversee and report on asset performance, review valuation outputs and identify questions or inconsistencies for escalation.
Risk and governance: Support the Senior Portfolio Manager in ensuring that funds are governed correctly and that information provided to Boards, customer boards, auditors and other governance forums is accurate. You will monitor risks including underperformance, valuation movements, liquidity, debt covenants, mandate constraints and material data gaps, escalating issues promptly.
Process improvement: Maintain accurate fund-level information for NAV, AUM, returns, distributions, commitments and track record, and look for practical improvements to reporting, controls, data collection and automation. You will help ensure that processes are documented, deadlines are managed and outputs are consistent and auditable
What You'll Need
At least three years of relevant experience in fund management, fund accounting, financial reporting, audit, transaction services, infrastructure, renewable energy, valuations, investment analysis or a comparable analytical role.
A strong finance or accounting background. A CFA or accounting qualification would be advantageous.
Good understanding of fund-management processes, including NAV, valuations, AUM, investor reporting, cash-flow forecasting, distributions, audit and governance.
Strong Excel and financial-modelling skills, including the ability to review models, analyse assumptions, reconcile outputs and perform scenario and sensitivity analysis. A modelling test may form part of the recruitment process.
Experience of analysing investment, fund or asset performance and creating high-quality investor or management information.
Experience with renewable energy, infrastructure, real assets, private markets, listed investment vehicles or multi-asset portfolios would be advantageous.

Principali attività
Supportare la redazione delle offerte tecniche per la gestione informativa BIM in fase di gara e affiancare i team delle commesse operative;

Analizzare, verificare e gestire modelli BIM provenienti da committenze, designer e consulenti, curando flussi documentali, validazione dei dati e controllo delle quantità;
Sviluppare e aggiornare modelli BIM con software di authoring per il settore Costruzioni, integrando simulazioni 4D e attività di automazione/ottimizzazione, incluse logiche 4D e 5D;
Realizzare strumenti digitali, app, report e dashboard per l’analisi, la comunicazione e la valorizzazione dei dati BIM;
Partecipare al testing di nuovi software e ai programmi di innovazione aziendale collegati alla digitalizzazione dei processi BIM.

Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria o Architettura;
Almeno 3 anni di esperienza in società AEC (Architecture, Engineering and Construction) o presso general contractor, con necessaria esposizione a progetti infrastrutturali (strade, ferrovie, dighe ecc.);
Solide competenze nell’utilizzo di software BIM quali: Autodesk Revit, Civil 3D, Dynamo, Bentley OpenRail, Synchro 4D o altri;
Esperienza nell'utilizzo di linguaggi di programmazione (C#, Python);
Esperienza con realtà virtuale, realtà aumentata e visori;
Capacità di estrazione, organizzazione e capitalizzazione dati da modelli BIM e di operare su banche dati;
Esperienza nell'organizzazione, analisi e reportistica di dati e informazioni nel settore AEC;
Disponibilità a trasferte sia in Italia che all'estero;
Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese.
