Job Overview
Manages multiple consulting projects of varying complexity and ensures on-time and on-budget delivery for clients in the healthcare field. Contributes to new business development and maintaining and strengthening client base. May support the development of new offerings.
Essential Functions
Manages project teams including both internal and external resources in the design, development and delivery of client solutions.
Leads teams to review and analyze client requirements or challenges and develops and costs associated proposals that ensure profitability and high client satisfaction with limited if any senior management input.
Manages the process of proposal preparation and/or modifications including overall bid integrity.
Develops project plan with timelines and deliverables and leads project to successful completion, on-time and on-budget, from start to finish with limited senior management guidance.
Recommends improvements and alternative solutions to resolve problems.
Serves as key point of contact with client.
Provides high level input to, and ensures the development of, client reports and presentations and delivers all or significant portions of findings to client.
Develops and/or elevates new business opportunities through the identification of follow-on work and new leads.
Provides follow-up with client after project deliverable have been completed to ensure client satisfaction.
Proactively continues to strengthen subject matter expertise through on the job experience, participation in conferences and symposiums and other forums for professional knowledge sharing.
Proactively mentors, coaches and shares subject matter expertise with others to elevate our capabilities to deliver world-class solutions for clients.
Qualifications
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent
8-12 years of related experience including consulting and healthcare industry experience
Demonstrates excellent project management skills and client influencing and relationship building skills.
In-depth understanding of IQVIA data assets and the IQVIA core offerings.
Works willingly and effectively with others in and across the organization to accomplish team goals.
Experienced with developing consultative relationships with senior level managers and executives at clients in the healthcare industry.
Ability to manage multiple projects, juggle priorities and deliver on tight deadlines.
Knowledge of consulting methodologies, tools and techniques related to functional area.
Knowledge of key issues and current developments in the healthcare industry.
Excellent presentation, communication and client influencing skills.
Has established network and referral contacts.
Possesses the necessary subject matter expertise and project management skills able to effectively manage projects across more than one CoE.
IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at https://jobs.iqvia.com
IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

records.title: Local Clinical Project Manager - Sponsor Dedicated

jd.text:
Job Description Summary
Job Overview
Project Leads are an integral part of clinical trial delivery, liaising with clinical teams to improve patients’ lives by bringing new drugs to the market faster. The Project Lead is an essential member of the core project team responsible for project delivery of clinical studies to meet contractual requirements in accordance with SOPs, policies and practices. Clinical Project Management is focused on project delivery, productivity and quality resulting in strong financial performance and customer satisfaction. Clinical Project leads can run their own studies. The Project Lead focus is on leveraging therapeutic expertise and IQVIA’s suite of solutions to drive operational excellence and strategic leadership with our customers
Essential Functions
Participate in bid defense presentations in partnership with Business Development and may lead the presentation for smaller, less complex regional studies.
May be responsible for delivery and management of smaller, less complex, regional studies.
Develop integrated study management plans with the core project team.
Accountable for the execution of clinical studies, or assigned portion of clinical studies, per contract while optimizing speed, quality and cost of delivery and ensuring consistent use of study tools and training materials and compliance with standard processes, policies and procedures.
Set objectives of the core project team and/or sub-team(s) according to agreed upon contract, strategy and approach, effectively communicate and assess performance.
Collaborate with other functional groups within the company where necessary to support milestone achievement and to manage study issues and obstacles.
Monitor progress against contract and prepare/present project and/or sub-team information proactively to stakeholders internally and externally.
Manage risk (positive and negative) and contingencies proactively and lead problem solving and resolution efforts.

As Director, Pricing and Contracting, Immunology, you will play a critical role in developing and implementing launch and in-market pricing strategies that maximize patient access and optimize the long-term value of Novartis assets. Reporting to the Executive Director, Pricing and Contracting, Immunology, you will partner closely with Therapeutic Areas, Strategy & Growth, Access, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, Finance, Policy, and key markets to drive strategic pricing decisions across the product lifecycle. This highly collaborative international role offers the opportunity to influence pricing strategy, launch sequencing, business case development, and contracting approaches while serving as a trusted advisor to stakeholders across regions and countries. Job Description Summary
#LI-Hybrid
Location: London, UK
This role is based in London, UK. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role. Please only apply if this location is accessible for you.
Complex data are integral to our work in clinical studies. This position is part of the Advanced Quantitative Sciences (AQS) Technology & AI function at Novartis. Our mission is to use automation and artificial intelligence to unlock the potential of complex scientific data, speed up quantitative decision-making in clinical trials, and bring innovative medicines to patients faster.
Our new Statistical Computing Environment (SCE) is changing how AQS works, from how programming and QC are done in the SCE to how outputs flow across the AQS Digital workflow. The AI & Automation Catalyst turns that technology into lasting changes in daily practice. You will co-lead, with engineering and business partners, the rollout of AI and automation into the how we generate evidence. That covers redesigning processes, being a technical champion, bringing stakeholders along, and making sure new ways of working are adopted, compliant and deliver measurable value.
This is a technical role and a change role, not one or the other. You are credible enough with engineers and programmers to shape solutions and challenge designs. You are also skilled enough with people to move senior stakeholders, line functions and skeptical end users from pilot to standard practice.
Job Description
Major accountabilities:
Leads translation of AI and automation into production. Owns the adoption roadmap for AI/automation that includes tools that span from the current-state process baseline, through future-state design and pilots, to scaled rollout.
Connects technology and business. Translates needs into clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria. Works hand in hand with AI & Data Engineering, SCE platform teams and IT to shape solutions. Makes informed technical trade-offs across build vs. configure, human-in-the-loop design and validation effort.
Manages stakeholders and influences without authority. Builds strong relationships across statistical programming, biostatistics, QA, line leadership and governance forums. Gets sponsors aligned, handles resistance, and turns different priorities into agreed decisions in a matrix organisation.
Redesigns processes and operating models. Redesigns QC and review workflows so AI and automation inform the standard process, and are not a bolt on. Updates SOPs, work instructions, RACI and role definitions with process owners.
Drives adoption and builds capability. Designs and runs change plans covering communications, training, champion networks, office hours and feedback loops. Tracks adoption and sentiment, and adjusts the approach based on the evidence.
Keeps change safe, compliant and inspection-ready. Understands GxP, computerised system validation and data integrity in drug development. Makes sure AI-assisted steps have the right risk assessment, human oversight, traceability and documentation. Works with QA and Compliance so the change holds up in audit.
Stays hands-on where it matters. Prototypes, reviews code and runs proofs of concept when that speeds up a decision or unblocks adoption. Offers expert guidance on complex data and automation problems.
Remains current with industry trends, and brings in external good practice on AI adoption in regulated environments through industry consortia, conferences and publications.
Fosters a culture of continuous learning, constructive challenge and innovation. Role-models transparent, responsible use of AI.
Essential Requirements:
MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, Biostatistics, Bioinformatics or another quantitative discipline. Equivalent experience considered.
Extensive experience in technology delivery in life sciences or another regulated industry, with at least 3 years leading technology-enabled business change or transformation.
Proven record of taking AI/automation or digital solutions from pilot to scaled, sustained adoption, with measured business impact.
Working knowledge of clinical data flows and statistical programming (e.g. SDTM/ADaM, TFLs, double programming/QC), statistical computing environments, and GxP/CSV expectations.
Solid technical foundation: can read and write R and/or Python, and understands software engineering practices (version control, testing, CI/CD, release management). Practical understanding of LLM/agentic AI applications and their limits, including evaluation, human-in-the-loop design and risk.
Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills at all levels, including senior leadership. Comfortable challenging and handling resistance in a matrix environment.
Fluent English, verbal and written. Can tell a clear, evidence-led story to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Desirable Requirements:
Change management certification, Lean/Six Sigma, or product owner/agile certification or experience.
Experience with Domino or similar analytics platforms, and with CDISC initiatives / metadata-driven automation.
External profile through publications, industry working groups or conference talks.

jd.text:
Head of Autoimmune Diabetes T1D Italy
Location: Milan
Job type: Permanent, Full-time
About the role
As Head of Autoimmune Diabetes T1D Italy , you will lead the launch in Italy of this breakthrough therapy. You'll drive commercial strategy, build health system readiness, and help redefine the standard of care in preventive medicine — all while working in one of pharma's most dynamic and high-visibility spaces. You will report directly to the General Manager and also be a member of the GenMed Italy leadership team, having a meaningful impact above your T1D franchise Head role and supporting the vision and ambition of the entire GBU in Italy.
Ready to get started ?
About Sanofi:
At Sanofi, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives. Tzield/Teizeild — our first-in-class, disease-modifying therapy for Autoimmune Type 1 Diabetes — is re-defining the way we used to manage T1D.
Approved in the US, EU, UK, China, Canada, Australia and beyond, it delays the onset of stage 3 T1D and gives patients and families more time and hope. Our target is to launch it in Italy by mid-2027.
Key Responsibilities :
Lead the T1D team to launch successfully Tzield/Teizeild in the Italy co-build the Integrated Growth Plan with Global, translate insights into local execution, and track performance through meaningful KPIs
Collaborate cross-functionally (e.g., Medical, Market Access, Public Affairs, Communications) — define a broad stakeholder engagement strategy by understanding how stakeholders impact each other in ecosystem (e.g., COEs, KOLs, HCPs, DOLs, scientific societies, PAGs, policy makers, payers, think-tanks, etc.) and tailor engagement to their level of maturity in T1D journey
Adapt and execute Glocal state of the art — multi-factorial stakeholder engagement to local context (incl. Omnichannel with compelling narrative/content)
Secure optimal market access for Teizeild — obtain the best access that reflects its therapeutic innovation
Drive treatment launch uptake — support infusion readiness in the centers of excellence, develop acceptance of Teizeild, conviction in the health care community, to establish it as the reference therapy in pre-clinical T1D
undefined
Shape the healthcare system to ensure full readiness at time of launch and beyond: Accelerate screening — scale the detection of at-risk patients at the right moment in their T1D journey, building on established foundations
& Accompany the long-term screening access strategy in Italy — coordinate action across Population Health, Medical, Public Affairs and Communications to secure sustainable access to screening
Drive innovation to accelerate and simplify the pre-clinical T1D patient journey — leverage AI models to identify at-risk patients and predict disease progression, enabling earlier and more precise intervention
Expand the ecosystem — strengthen partnerships across screening players, COEs, payers and patient communities to ensure a seamless pathway from screening to treatment
Anticipate the future of immunotherapy in T1D — beyond Teizeild, help shape the landscape for Sanofi's upcoming pipeline innovations and establish Sanofi's scientific leadership in T1D
Monitor and stay ahead of market trends and developments — drive improvements in business outcomes and customer experience
Lead and grow the team — continue developing a best-in-class commercial organization (marketing, sales, patient experience, pathway management) with an intrapreneurial mindset
Contribute in the GenMed Italy Leadership team as core member to define the vision, roadmap and ambition of GenMed Italy including performance, transformation and talent development.
About you :
Experience: Desired experience in Specialty / Rare disease / Type 1 Diabetes
At least 10 years of industry experience in Sales / Marketing on launch brands, ideally with disease area shaping. Skills in brand planning, Omnichannel strategy, Sales teams leadership with a strong focus on customer centricity and excellence in execution; Demonstrated successful Brand P&L Ownership accountability
Above country experience in a Global or Regional role is a plus
Led Local Brand Team
Soft skills:
Strong ability to lead, simplify and move at pace large complex programs
Ability to provide strategic guidance and vision
Appetite for execution and strong team player mindset including excellence in medical collaboration
Self-driven, results-oriented operating with high standards of ambition and collaboration ("the what and the how")
Leadership and people development: Ability to build, engage and develop the team, delegate effectively, celebrate diversity within the team, and drive performance
Excellent communication skills with the ability to build and cultivate effective relationships, and to influence and collaborate internally and externally at all organizational levels
Curiosity to contribute beyond scope in the GenMed Italian Leadership Team
Technical skills:
Experience in building partnerships with key stakeholders (universities, hospitals, healthcare providers etc) and leveraging Omnichannel
Deep understanding of the Italian healthcare ecosystem
Capability to be strategic while mastering the details/execution when needed
Strategic thinking and strong analytical skills
Education: Advanced Bachelor's degree in business, life sciences, or a related field
Languages: Strong communication and presentation skills in English and Italian both written and verbal
Why choose us ?
Help shape the future of care for chronic and complex conditions like aT1D, Type 2 diabetes, transplant, and cardiovascular disease.
Drive meaningful impact at global scale: our medicines reach more than 100 million people each year
Be part of a simpler, digital- and AI-powered business that’s
rethinking how we work and engage with the world.
#LI-EUR
#LI-HYBRID
Pursue progress , discover extraordinary
Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.
At Sanofi, we provide equal opportunities to all regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, ability or gender identity.
Watch our ALL IN video and check out our Diversity Equity and Inclusion actions at sanofi.com !
The salary range for this position is :€99.200,00 - €132.267 Final compensation will be determined based on demonstrated experience, skills, location, and other relevant factors. Employees may be eligible to participate in Company employee benefit programs.

About us
Sky è la t ech media company che rende l’intrattenimento e la connettività un’esperienza personale, semplice e senza confini.
Il nostro motto è We Believe in Better : crediamo che le persone meritino il meglio e innoviamo ogni giorno per creare valore e semplificare la vita dei nostri clienti.
Siamo parte di Sky Group e del mondo Comcast, operiamo in una realtà internazionale orientata all’innovazione continua e sostenuta da una tecnologia di eccellenza che ci permette di raggiungere ogni giorno milioni di persone.
Con un approccio IP-first progettiamo piattaforme tecnologiche all’avanguardia - Sky Stream, Sky Q, Sky Glass e NOW - che integrano contenuti premium, informazione autorevole e non-stop, grandi eventi sportivi in un ecosistema semplice e intuitivo.
Parliamo a tutto il Paese anche attraverso i canali Free to air - TV8, Cielo e Sky TG24 - e andiamo oltre l’intrattenimento con Sky Wifi e Sky Mobile, offrendo connettività ultraveloce dentro e fuori casa.
È così che portiamo la joy of a better experience , guidati dai nostri valori:
Creative. Siamo ambiziosi e innovativi, abbracciando le nuove tecnologie e utilizzando gli insight per rimanere un passo avanti, alzando l’asticella della qualità per i nostri clienti.
Welcoming. Siamo inclusivi, collaborativi e rispettosi, creando un senso di appartenenza.
Simplifying. Ci concentriamo su ciò che conta davvero, definiamo le priorità, portiamo chiarezza ed eliminiamo la complessità.
Do the right thing. Costruiamo una cultura basata su chiarezza, equità e fiducia con processi trasparenti e decisioni in cui le persone possano avere fiducia.
Ruolo
Come Senior Financial Accounting entrerai a far parte del team Finance e contribuirai a garantire accuratezza, integrità e conformità dei processi contabili e delle attività di reporting finanziario.
All’interno di un contesto internazionale e strutturato, supporterai la predisposizione del bilancio d’esercizio secondo principi IFRS e contribuirai alle attività di consolidamento, assicurando il corretto trattamento contabile delle operazioni in coerenza con gli standard IFRS, le Group Accounting policies e i requisiti US GAAP.
Lavorerai a stretto contatto con Shared Service Center, stakeholder Finance e team cross-funzionali, contribuendo al presidio dei controlli interni, alla qualità delle riconciliazioni contabili e al miglioramento continuo dei processi di chiusura e reporting.
Cosa farai
Gestirai e supporterai le attività contabili nel rispetto dei principi contabili IFRS e US GAAP.
Predisporrai il bilancio d’esercizio redatto secondo principi IFRS e contribuirai alla preparazione del bilancio consolidato.
Assicurerai il rispetto dei controlli SOX e dei framework di controllo interno per le aree di responsabilità assegnate.
Supporterai l’analisi contabile di contratti e operazioni complesse, garantendo il corretto trattamento in linea con IFRS, Group Accounting policies e principi US GAAP.
Ti coordinerai con gli Shared Service Center per monitorare, verificare e validare le riconciliazioni contabili.
Collaborerai con i team Finance e con gli stakeholder di business a supporto dei processi di chiusura mensile, trimestrale e annuale.
Identificherai e analizzerai tematiche contabili, proponendo soluzioni efficaci con approccio proattivo e orientato al problem solving.
Supporterai le attività di audit interno ed esterno, predisponendo documentazione accurata e fornendo competenze contabili specialistiche.
Contribuirai a iniziative di miglioramento continuo finalizzate a rendere più efficaci processi, controlli e attività di reporting.
Il tuo profilo
Hai conseguito una laurea in Economia, Accounting, Finance o discipline affini.
Hai maturato almeno 4-5 anni di esperienza in ruoli contabili, preferibilmente in contesti complessi, strutturati e multinazionali.
Hai una solida conoscenza dei principi contabili IFRS, US GAAP e dei requisiti di financial reporting.
Hai esperienza nella predisposizione del bilancio d’esercizio IFRS e nel supporto alla redazione del bilancio consolidato.
Hai maturato esperienza in ambito SOX compliance e controllo interno.
Sai analizzare scenari contabili complessi, con attenzione al dettaglio, metodo e capacità di sintesi.
Hai ottime capacità organizzative e sai gestire più priorità e scadenze in parallelo.
Ti contraddistinguono approccio proattivo, problem solving e capacità di collaborare efficacemente con stakeholder diversi.
La precedente esperienza in una società Big 4 sarà considerata un plus.
L’esperienza di lavoro con o all’interno di Shared Service Center sarà considerata un plus.
Hai una conoscenza avanzata di Microsoft Excel e dei principali sistemi contabili/ERP; la conoscenza di SAP sarà considerata un plus.
Parli e scrivi fluentemente in inglese.
Cosa offriamo
Per il CCNL Radio e televisioni private la retribuzione è a partire da: 45000 €
Tipologia contrattuale: indeterminato
La retribuzione effettiva sarà commisurata alla esperienza maturata e alle competenze specifiche possedute.
La posizione è inoltre eligible al sistema incentivante annuale.
Sky considera prioritario fornire un ambiente di lavoro sano, stimolante e attento alle esigenze individuali, sia nella sfera quotidiana che professionale. In quest’ottica nasce Sky4You, il programma di Wellbeing concepito per accompagnare ogni persona nelle diverse fasi della vita, alcuni esempi di ciò che avrai a disposizione:
Accesso gratuito all’offerta televisiva Sky tramite Sky Q o Sky Stream
Sky Wifi e Sky Mobile a condizioni riservate ed esclusive
Assicurazione sanitaria estendibile ai familiari e conviventi
Polizza vita e infortuni
Accesso gratuito alla palestra aziendale [solo sede di Milano]
Sostegno economico per neo genitori e caregiver
Assistenza gratuita per la dichiarazione dei redditi
Buoni pasto
A questi si aggiungono iniziative dedicate al benessere psico-fisico e finanziario, campus estivi e corsi di lingua per figli/e, oltre a convenzioni e sconti riservati.
Hybrid Working
Lavoro ibrido che funziona davvero. In base al tuo ruolo potrai usufruire fino a un massimo di 12 giorni al mese di smart working per concentrarti senza distrazioni; in ufficio potrai confrontarti, creare insieme e prendere decisioni in spazi unici pensati per collaborare e dare il meglio di te.
Il nostro hub di Milano si trova a Rogoredo, nel quartiere Santa Giulia, a pochi minuti a piedi dalla stazione Milano Rogoredo (M3 Rogoredo FS, treni regionali/AV, Passante), zona ben servita anche da un servizio di bus. Facile da raggiungere anche in auto e motocicli, grazie ai collegamenti con le principali arterie cittadine.
Nello Sky Campus troverai: due bar, ristorante aziendale, lo Sky Cinema e vari spazi collaborativi dedicati all’innovazione e alla condivisione di idee. Nei dintorni troverai altri bar, ristoranti, supermercati e servizi vari.
Formazione e crescita
In Sky investiamo nella tua crescita. Crediamo nella mobilità interna come leva concreta di sviluppo e ti offriamo opportunità per esplorare nuovi ruoli e percorsi all’interno dell’azienda. Con Sky Learn, la nostra piattaforma di apprendimento, avrai accesso a formazione continua, contenuti digitali e percorsi di upskilling e reskilling per crescere, evolvere e costruire il tuo futuro professionale.
Social Impact & Inclusion
In Sky crediamo nelle persone. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente diverso, equo e inclusivo, in cui ogni persona possa sentirsi sé stessa ed esprimere il proprio potenziale. Sosteniamo attivamente il benessere e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutti, incluse le persone appartenenti alle categorie protette (Legge 68/99).
In quest’ottica, l’azienda ospita i network Body&Mind, LGBTQ+, Women@Sky e Parents&Carers: community volontarie che riuniscono colleghi interessati a confrontarsi e promuovere iniziative dedicate al benessere, all’inclusione e all’empowerment femminile.
Lavoriamo ogni giorno per generare un impatto positivo e duraturo sulle comunità, grazie alle iniziative di volontariato Sky Cares, ai programmi di educazione digitale di SkyUp e alle esperienze immersive delle company visit degli Academy Studios.
Perché aspettare?
Candidati ora per costruire una carriera straordinaria ed entrare a far parte di un team brillante. Non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti! In Sky le idee diventano esperienze per milioni di persone.
Sky favorisce l’inserimento di ogni forma di talento. Tutte le candidature, incluse quelle appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi della Legge 68/99, saranno considerate in ottica di pari opportunità e inclusione, senza discriminazioni di alcun tipo. Sky Italia garantisce un processo di selezione equo, inclusivo e non discriminatorio.
In coerenza con questo impegno e con il D. Lgs 96/2026, Sky Italia non richiede né raccoglie informazioni sulla retribuzione o sull’inquadramento pregressi dei/delle candidati/e, né durante i colloqui, né tramite contatti individuali e/o attraverso altri soggetti terzi coinvolti nel processo.

jd.text:
Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
Specialty Credit & Political Risk Graduate Programme
Please read before submitting : You may only apply to one graduate programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in them not being considered.
Location: London
Start date: September 2027
Salary: £40,000
Working structure: Hybrid
Credit & Political Risk Graduate Programme
Help Shape Global Trade, Finance and Investment
Looking for a graduate role where you'll combine analytical thinking, commercial awareness and relationship-building whilst being at the centre of geopolitical events ? Join Ho wden's Credit & Political Risk team and learn how we help organisations navigate the risks that come with lending, trading and investing around the world.
From supporting major infrastructure projects to protecting international trade transactions, we work with financial institutions, corporates, funds and public entities across a wide range of industries. As part of our global team, you'll gain exposure to complex risks, innovative solutions and some of the most interesting transactions in the market.
This is a fast-paced, international environment where y ou'll develop both technical knowledge and commercial skills while learning how transactions are negotiated, structured and executed.
This is a permanent role supported by a structured development programme, designed to accelerate your technical expertise , professional confidence and long-term career growth.
What you’ll be doin g?
You'll begin with a structured induction before joining the Credit & Political Risk team, where you'll work alongside experienced specialists on live client projects.
During the programme, you'll:
Learn how Credit & Political Risk Insurance supports businesses, financial institutions and investors operating around the world.
Support the placement of insurance solutions that help clients manage financial and political risks.
Research countries, industries, companies and market trends to support client activity and business development.
Assist in preparing client presentations, reports and insurance submissions.
Build relationships with clients, insurers and internal teams across the business.
Wh o are we looking for?
No insurance experience is needed ; we’ll teach you everything you need to know!
You'll be:
A recent graduate, or in your final year of university study from any degree background.
Interested in global markets, international business and current affairs, with a curiosity about how organisations manage financial and political risks.
A strong communicator who enjoys building relationships with a range of people.
Analytical and naturally curious, and willing to ask questions.
Comfortable working with numbers and data to support decision-making and problem-solving.
Organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Resilient and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.
Someone who takes ownership, shows initiative and enjoys learning new concepts and industries.
A collaborative team player who enjoys working across various teams.
To be eligible for our programme, you must have the full and unrestricted right to work in the UK.
Application process
Our application process is designed to help you show your potential, not to test what you already know!
Online application form – no CV required : We believe you're more than just a document, so we won’t ask you to submit a CV. Please upload a blank document on the application form.
Online gamified assessment: We’ve created games that will help us understand your natural strengths and how you approach different situations. There are no right or wrong answers. You can complete this stage on your phone or laptop, whichever suits you best!
Pre-recorded video interview: You will record your answers to a few questions using your phone or laptop, giving you the chance to tell us more about yourself in your own time in a relaxed setting.
Assessment centre: Our final stage is an in-person assessment centre at one of our offices. You'll take part in some fun group activities and meet our team in a relaxed setting. This day is all about getting to know you better and for you to see what it's like to be part of Howden and experience our culture. We'll cover all your travel costs for this day , because where you are now, shouldn’t hold back your future!
Why should you apply?
At Howden, people are at the heart of everything we do. As an employee-owned business, we believe success is built through collaboration, learning and supporting one another. You'll join a permanent role from day one and take part in our structured 18-month development programme, designed to accelerate your technical, commercial and professional growth.
You'll also benefit from:
A starting salary of £40,000 and a generous pension scheme.
Opportunity to complete fully funded professional qualifications, such as the CII or CFA, to support your long-term career development.
Structured learning and development through our 18-month graduate development programme.
25 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays and an additional day off at Christmas.
Access to discounted personal health policies, wellbeing support and a range of employee benefits and insurance products.
2 days allocated to take part in volunteering schemes.
Ready to apply?
Follow our TikTok pages: @earlycareersjo and @millieinsurancecareers, and explore our Connectr hub to discover more about Howden, our culture, and the insurance industry. You'll find resources to help you prepare for our recruitment process and understand which career path could be the best fit for you .
Please read before submitting : You may only apply to on e graduate programme for our 2027 intake. Submitting duplicate applications will result in additional applications not being considered.
What do we offer in return?
A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond
Reasonable adjustments
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.
If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.
*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.
Permanent

Loan Agency Specialist
Location: London, UK | Full-time
Join a Team at the Centre of Complex Financing Transactions. Help deliver high-profile syndicated loan transactions across EMEA while working with borrowers, lenders, legal counsel, and internal stakeholders. This is a great opportunity to build your expertise in a client-facing role with exposure to a broad range of financing structures and industry sectors.
The Team
The London Agency team is part of ING's wider EMEA Agency platform. Acting as Facility and Security Agent on syndicated loans, the team coordinates transactions across sectors including Corporate Banking, Real Estate, Infrastructure, Shipping, and Acquisition Finance. Working closely with offshore colleagues, the team is focused on delivering a high-quality, client-centric service while continuously improving processes and controls.
Roles and Responsibilities
As a Loan Agency Specialist, you will support the successful execution and ongoing management of syndicated lending transactions by:
Managing deal closings, funds flow, and transaction onboarding.
Reviewing facility documentation to ensure compliance with internal policies and market standards.
Coordinating with lenders, borrowers, legal counsel, and internal stakeholders to deliver transaction milestones.
Acting as the primary contact for agency-related queries and issue resolution.
Facilitating amendments, waivers, consents, and syndicate communications.
Investigating operational issues and mitigating transaction risks.
Overseeing offshore servicing activities to ensure excellent client delivery.
How to Succeed
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
To be successful in this role, you'll bring proven experience within Loans Agency operations, with a strong understanding of credit documentation and the ability to confidently interpret complex loan agreements. Experience using LoanIQ is essential, enabling you to manage transactions accurately and efficiently from day one.
You'll thrive in a fast-paced environment, balancing multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills will help you identify issues quickly and deliver effective solutions, while your excellent communication skills will enable you to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
We're looking for someone who is proactive, organised, and results-driven, with the confidence to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team. You'll enjoy taking ownership, showing initiative, and contributing to a culture where challenges are embraced and opportunities are acted upon.
Candidates with exposure to Structured Finance products, such as Real Estate, Acquisition, Shipping, or Infrastructure Finance, will be particularly well placed to succeed. Experience with DebtDomain, ClearPar, or Security Agent activities would be advantageous, as would a passion for continuous improvement, innovation, and challenging the status quo.
Rewards and benefits
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life https://careers.ing.com/en/UKHome
The benefits of working with us at ING include:
Comprehensive health cover, including private medical, dental, vision, health screening and in-person GP appointments
Generous pension scheme and financial protection, including life assurance, income protection, access to pension guidance and will writing services, and an interest-free season ticket loan
Hybrid working and flexibility to work remotely for up to 30 days abroad
Generous annual leave, with the option to purchase additional days and time off for key life events
Wellbeing and family support, including an Employee Assistance Programme, back-up child and elder care, enhanced family leave policies and support coaching for new parents
Lifestyle benefits such as electric vehicle and cycle to work schemes, an on-site gym and access to on-site staff restaurant and barista coffee facilities
Opportunities for personal and professional growth through mentoring, learning, short-term assignments and international career development
Opportunities to build strong connections through volunteering, employee forums and social clubs
About us
Curious about how ING empowers people and businesses to move forward? Discover what we do and what we can offer you.

eFX Platform Engineering Product Owner
London | Full-time | Permanent
Help shape and run the technology that supports a busy electronic FX trading and sales environment. This role combines hands-on platform engineering with Product Owner ownership: contributing to technical delivery, strengthening service resilience, and helping turn stakeholder priorities into a clear, actionable team backlog.
The team
The London e FX platform team supports, maintains and develops trading technology within the Financial Markets Technology domain. We work in an agile delivery model and focus on reliable service, secure change, observability, automation, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with engineers, front-office stakeholders, IT management, tribe product managers and chapter leads to keep the platform stable today while shaping the roadmap for tomorrow.
Roles and responsibilities
As an engineering-focused Product Owner, you will stay close to the technology while helping the team deliver the right outcomes. You will:
Contribute to platform engineering, support and change delivery, keeping stability, reliability, security and operational quality at the centre of delivery.
Own and prioritise the team backlog, translating stakeholder needs, technical debt, risk items and service improvements into clear, actionable work.
Maintain the platform technical roadmap and align delivery priorities with stakeholders across trading, sales, IT management and product management.
Use strong analytical skills to break down incidents, service issues and technical problems, supporting root-cause analysis and measurable improvement actions.
Improve observability by strengthening meaningful monitoring, alerting, service-level measures and reporting using tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
Drive automation through Azure DevOps, pipelines, YAML and Ansible, reducing manual activity and improving repeatability, control and delivery confidence.
Support robust change, release and risk management practices, ensuring changes are planned, tested, deployed and evidenced appropriately.
Create transparency on capacity, delivery options and trade-offs, including input into Quarterly Business Review planning and stakeholder communication.
How to succeed
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you’ll stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we’ll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
You have strong technical knowledge across Linux and Windows environments, connectivity, automation, administration and operational tooling.
You can analyse complex technical or service issues, structure options clearly and turn findings into practical backlog items and improvement actions.
You understand agile delivery and can balance stakeholder priorities, team capacity, technical debt, risk and operational resilience.
You have experience with automation and delivery tooling such as Azure DevOps, YAML, Ansible or comparable pipeline technologies.
You understand service management, IT risk, security expectations and the evidence needed to demonstrate control in a financial-services environment.
You communicate clearly with engineers and senior stakeholders, work well in a team, and are comfortable taking ownership while helping others succeed.
Useful experience
Observability strategies and tooling, including meaningful monitoring, alerting and service-level reporting.
Resilient architecture concepts, including active-active designs, disaster recovery scenarios and recovery testing.
ITIL practices, incident management, problem management, change management and post-incident improvement.
Electronic markets, foreign exchange, trading platforms or other Financial Markets technology environments.
Product Owner, technical lead, service owner or platform ownership experience.
AI-assisted engineering or productivity tooling, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot or GitHub Copilot.
Rewards and benefits
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life.

Comprehensive health cover, including private medical, dental, vision, health screening and in-person GP appointments.

Hybrid working and flexibility to work remotely for up to 30 days abroad.

Lifestyle benefits such as electric vehicle and cycle to work schemes, an on-site gym and access to on-site staff restaurant and barista coffee facilities.
Opportunities for personal and professional growth through mentoring, learning, short-term assignments and international career development.

📢 Championing Diversity: People with disabilities encouraged to apply (L.68/99) 🚀
We Welcome Everyone!
This role is part of our commitment to fostering an inclusive workplace: this is why Satispay mainly dedicates this job opportunity to candidates eligible under specific employment protection laws, including those with disabilities or other protected status, in line with Italian law (L.68/99). We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
Still willing to apply for the role? This specific application form is dedicated mainly to candidates with disabilities. However, we value diversity and talent in all its forms, and everyone is welcome to apply for a job at Satispay! If you’re interested in the role, but you’re not a candidate with disabilities, visit the following link and apply here https://www.satispay.com/en-it/work-at-satispay/open-positions/f97f126b-a3db-41ce-bf91-63f8f4400cda/
About us
Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.
That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.
We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world.
If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.
What you'll be doing
As our Software Engineer, Backend, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of digital payments by designing and building scalable, high-quality systems, delivering features, gaining deep system context, and growing your technical expertise.
Here's what that looks like in practice:
Own the Story Lifecycle - Complete the entire story lifecycle from intake to production release, standing up product stories and ensuring all requirements are met.
Contribute to Technical Excellence - Conduct technical analysis for standard scope stories and implement robust, scalable back-end solutions.
Ensure Quality and Stability - Accurately estimate effort and resolve blockers promptly, participating in incident resolution, root cause analysis, and prevention to ensure technical transparency.
Document and Communicate - Create comprehensive technical documentation for the features you build and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.
Who we’re looking for
This role needs someone who is a problem solver, eager to learn, owns their work, and is ready to collaborate and take real ownership.
Experience & Technical Foundations - At least 3 years of industry experience working with Java and a foundational understanding of cloud platforms (AWS is a plus).
Structured Communication - Ability to communicate in a structured and convincing manner, adapting your style to build trust positively and professionally with various stakeholders, including coordinating implementation with other teams.
User Focus - Inherent desire to understand and address user needs, ensuring the back-end system supports a great user experience.
Passion and Language Skills - Passionate about FinTech or startup environments and fluent in English.
Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.
CareAbout: how we support your impact
We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:
❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
*We embrace two days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday), with the option to request extra remote time.
Salary: starting from €38,000 gross per annum
This range is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.
Equal opportunity employer
At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!
Learn more about us
Curious what it's actually like here? Our values and pillars shape how we work every day: explore them here https://www.satispay.com/en-it/work-at-satispay/.

What you'll be doing
As our Functional Training Coordinator, you'll own the strategy, coordination, and continuous improvement of function-specific training within our Product Compliance team to ensure teams across Satispay have the fintech knowledge and practical skills to excel.
Here's what that looks like in practice:
Learning Needs & Strategy - Assess fintech learning needs across the teams and functions you support, translating product and regulatory change into concrete capability gaps and a clear training strategy.
Curriculum Design & Ownership - Build and maintain role-based learning paths and curricula tailored to fintech domains (e.g., payments, lending, KYC/AML, licensing, consumer protection).
Program Coordination & Delivery - Mobilise internal subject matter experts and external providers to develop and deliver training, managing schedules, logistics, budgets, and stakeholder communications end-to-end.
Content & Regulatory Alignment - Keep training materials accurate and current as products, regulations, and policies evolve, partnering with Corporate Learning & Development to align functional and company-wide learning.
Impact Measurement & Continuous Improvement - Track participation, learning outcomes, and program effectiveness against defined KPIs, gathering feedback to keep improving initiatives and to support onboarding across the functions you serve.
Who we're looking for
This role needs someone organised, proactive, and collaborative, equipped with a solid understanding of the fintech landscape to elevate team capabilities across Satispay.
Experience - At least 2 years in learning & development, enablement, or program/project management, strongly preferred within the fintech, banking, or financial services sector.
Regulatory Knowledge - A working understanding of financial regulations and the fintech landscape, enough to translate regulatory and product change into clear, role-specific learning needs.
Proactive and Program-Driven Mindset - Ability to run multiple training initiatives independently in a fast-paced environment, coordinating technical and business subject matter experts and external vendors, while keeping training agile and timely.
Ownership and Team Contribution - Ability to take full accountability for the functional training program while collaborating across Product, Technology, Operations, Legal, Finance, Compliance, FinCrime, and other departments to embed capability into how teams work.
Technical Skills - Comfort with learning platforms (LMS) and practical approaches to measuring learning effectiveness. Instructional design experience or a background in compliance/risk is a strong plus.
Languages - Fluent in English, ensuring effective communication with international teams. Italian is a strong nice-to-have.
Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

Compliance collaboration - Work closely with compliance/legal given the regulated nature of investment products.
User research - Talk to users constantly (interviews, usability tests, support tickets) and turn what you hear into concrete product decisions.

KPI management - Track and own your core KPIs (activation, adoption, AUM/volumes) and report on them without spin.

Investments expertise - You bring a proven track record in the investment space, paired with a genuine, contagious passion for the world of finance
Data-driven mindset - You build hypotheses, validate them, and rely on analytics to lead the way
User-centric focus - You prioritize direct user feedback and research over unverified assumptions.

Champion Frictionless UX – Analyse security measures to identify unnecessary hurdles, designing dynamic friction strategies for a seamless user experience.
Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.

This role needs someone genuinely curious about how fraud works, and driven enough to stay one step ahead of it.
Experience – You have at least 6 years’ experience, specifically within the risk, payments, or credit sectors.
Technical Proficiency – You are highly skilled in SQL and Python for data analysis and strategy development.
Domain Expertise – You have a solid understanding of payment fraud dynamics and experience working with real-time decisioning environments.
Communication – You possess excellent communication skills and are fluent in English.

New Business Line Leadership – Drive the strategy and execution for BNPL products, taking features from 0 to 1 and managing their scaling phase.
Consumer-Facing Experience – Focus on the UX and customer-facing side of credit, ensuring complex financial tools are intuitive, transparent, and seamlessly integrated into Satispay.
Cross-functional Alignment – Act as a strategic orchestrator across Finance, Marketing, Data Science, and Fincrime/Fraud to align priorities around a shared product vision.
Product Definition & Documentation – Write clear user stories and requirements for Engineering, aligning frontend experiences with backend logic such as credit scoring and collection.
Data-Driven Optimization – Analyze product usage and performance metrics to optimize credit features and uncover new market opportunities.
Process Evangelism & Mentorship – Advocate for thorough documentation and efficient workflows to help the team anticipate obstacles and ensure smooth product delivery.

This role needs someone with the resilience to build a new business pillar and a problem-solving mindset focused on team-driven success.
Product Experience – 5+ years as a Product Manager, including at least 3 years specifically within the Credit domain.

Financial & Analytical Skills – Strong understanding of credit scoring, collection management, and overall financial mechanics.
Stakeholder Management – Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams (Engineering, UX, BI, Finance).

Questo ruolo fa parte del nostro impegno a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Per questo motivo, Satispay dedica questa specifica opportunità a persone con disabilità o appartenenti ad altre categorie protette, in conformità con la legge italiana sulla tutela dell’occupazione (L.68/99). Accogliamo candidature da persone con ogni tipo di percorso.
Non rientri tra i destinatari della L.68/99 ma vorresti comunque candidarti? Crediamo nel valore della diversità e del talento in tutte le sue forme! Se ti interessa questa posizione, ma non rientri tra le persone destinatarie della legge 68/99, clicca su questo link https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/satispay/db8bb67c-ab6c-4ef7-ab17-bd37fb7154f0?departmentId=2ca17579-a217-47be-bad2-8405d824ae83&utm_source=ourpeople per candidarti.
Chi siamo
Le banche tradizionali non ti hanno mai dato pieno controllo della tua vita finanziaria. Satispay esiste per cambiare le cose: per mettere il potere della finanza nelle mani delle persone.
Questo significa rendere i servizi finanziari semplici e accessibili per oltre 6,5M di utenti. Abbiamo iniziato dai pagamenti, poi i benefit, gli investimenti, le carte… e non abbiamo finito. Anzi, siamo solo all’inizio. Ogni volta seguiamo la stessa logica: trovare un problema reale, risolverlo come si deve, e passare al successivo. La destinazione? Costruire la piattaforma finanziaria più amata al mondo. Se ti prendi la responsabilità dei risultati e non solo dei compiti, se resti accanto a ciò di cui le persone hanno bisogno e non aspetti che siano gli altri a sistemare quello che non funziona — qui troverai persone che lavorano esattamente come te. E insieme costruirete qualcosa di cui essere fieri.
Cosa farai con noi
Come Inside Business Developer - Payments, avrai la responsabilità di espandere e massimizzare il valore dei nostri merchant attraverso la promozione telefonica di soluzioni di pagamento innovative.
Ecco cosa significa nella pratica:
Ampliare il network di Satispay - Acquisendo nuove attività commerciali che aderiscano al Network Satispay, con un focus primario sulla conversione di lead inbound.
Sviluppare il valore della Customer Base - Ingaggiando i merchant già attivi per promuovere l'adozione di nuove funzionalità e soluzioni Premium tramite attività di upsell.
Gestire trattative - Utilizzando capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione per ingaggiare e convertire efficacemente ogni cliente (inbound o outbound) in tempi brevi.
Gestire pipeline tramite CRM - Gestendo autonomamente il funnel di acquisizione e sviluppo su CRM HubSpot, rispettando gli standard di compliance richiesti.
Promuovere la soluzione Satispay - Spiegando i vantaggi, la semplicità e l'innovazione dei nostri servizi di pagamento ai potenziali merchant e ai partner esistenti.
Chi stiamo cercando
Per questo ruolo cerchiamo una persona fortemente motivata, con ottime capacità relazionali e di negoziazione, pronta a prendersi la responsabilità del raggiungimento dei target commerciali.
Intraprendenza - Hai una forte motivazione a metterti in gioco e a crescere professionalmente in un ambiente dinamico e ad alto ritmo.
Eccellenti doti relazionali - Sei capace di instaurare rapporti di fiducia immediati, positivi e professionali con interlocutori molto diversi tra loro.
Capacità persuasive e resilienza - Dimostri sicurezza nell'approccio telefonico, sai ascoltare attivamente e trasformare le obiezioni in opportunità di business.
Orientamento all’obiettivo - Ti trovi a tuo agio a lavorare con KPI chiari e definiti, ti motivano gli obiettivi e ami raggiungerli e superarli.
Passione per il Fintech e l'Innovazione - Hai un forte interesse per il mondo dei pagamenti digitali e per come la tecnologia possa semplificare il business dei nostri merchant.
Non preoccuparti se non ti riconosci in ogni singolo requisito. Crediamo nella forza di prospettive e talenti diversi. Il tuo punto di vista è importante mentre costruiamo qualcosa di speciale: se hai passione e pensi di poter fare la differenza, ti incoraggiamo a candidarti.
CareAbout: come supportiamo il tuo impatto
Andiamo veloci e la nostra evoluzione non si ferma mai. È un percorso entusiasmante, ma può essere sfidante. Per assicurarci che le nostre persone possano dare il meglio di sé, ci impegniamo a semplificare la loro vita, sia in ufficio che fuori.
Ecco perché è nato CareAbout:
❤️ Salute: assicurazione privata per te e la tua famiglia, supporto psicologico con Serenis, workshop sul benessere mentale.
💰 Risorse finanziarie: piano di Stock Option, Buoni Pasto, supporto al trasferimento se cambi Paese.
⚙️ Crescita e sviluppo: programmi di formazione professionale, mobilità interna, corsi di lingua con Preply.
🌱 Flessibilità: ferie illimitate, policy di lavoro ibrido*, orari flessibili.
👨‍👩‍👧 Famiglia: congedo parentale esteso, permessi extra per malattia dei figli.
*Prevediamo tre giorni a settimana in ufficio (martedì, giovedì + 1 altro giorno a tua scelta), con la possibilità di richiedere periodi extra di lavoro da remoto.
Stipendio: €25,000 - €32,000 lordi all'anno + variabile
Questi valori sono definiti sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere, in linea con i requisiti fondamentali della posizione. Tuttavia, crediamo che non si debba imporre un limite al talento. Il pacchetto retributivo finale sarà personalizzato in base alla tua esperienza e alle tue competenze uniche. Se ritieni che il tuo profilo vada oltre i requisiti standard, ti invitiamo a candidarti comunque: saremo felici di valutare insieme un'offerta che rifletta il tuo reale valore.
Equal-Opportunity Employer
In Satispay, siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità. Celebriamo la diversità e l'inclusione, accogliendo persone di ogni provenienza. Questa opportunità è aperta a tutti, indipendentemente, ad esempio, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere, orientamento sessuale e origine nazionale. Unisciti a noi in un luogo di lavoro dove tutti si sentono parte!

records.title: Chief Financial Officer - Satispay Bank
records.location: Luxembourg, Luxembourg | London, UK | Barcelona, Spain | Amsterdam, Netherlands

jd.text:
About us
Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.
That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.
What you'll be doing
As CFO for our Luxembourg-regulated entity, you will be primarily responsible for maintaining the financial integrity, regulatory compliance, and fiscal oversight of Satispay's European hub. Acting as a regulator-approved key executive, your role involves aligning ambitious group-wide corporate goals with the demands of banking compliance, managing the local balance sheet, and safeguarding the entity's capital adequacy.
You will lead the entity's scalable Finance function, including statutory reporting, financial control, audit coordination, finance operations, and integration with the Group Finance organisation to support Satispay's growth and regulatory evolution.
Here's what that looks like in practice:
Reporting & Compliance: Take full accountability for the preparation and delivery of local statutory accounts, regulatory filings, and financial information required for Group consolidation, ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, compliance, and timeliness. Ensure adherence to Lux GAAP/IFRS, applicable regulatory requirements, and Group reporting policies.
Financial Strategy & Liquidity: Oversee the management of liquidity risks and the protection of client funds as per e-money statutes, while implementing effective yield-enhancement tactics for surplus liquidity. Lead treasury activities across the Luxembourg entity, including cash management, cash forecasting, and coordination with the Treasury team.
Risk Management: Track and uphold institutional capital benchmarks, establishing proactive detection mechanisms for market and liquidity exposures. Partner closely with the Chief Risk Officer and other control functions to ensure effective oversight of financial risks, including liquidity, capital, and balance sheet-related risks.
Stakeholder Representation: Act as Satispay's primary financial representative to regulatory bodies, tax offices, and external auditors, ensuring the successful execution of annual audits.
Financial Control & Performance Reporting: Oversee the Financial Control and Controlling functions, ensuring accurate month-end reporting, balance sheet integrity, and timely management information for local and Group stakeholders. Provide financial analysis and insights to support strategic decision-making and business performance monitoring.
Finance Operations: Ensure efficient and scalable Finance Operations processes, including reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end close activities. Establish and maintain a strong financial control environment across all operational finance processes.
Intercompany Integration: Work closely with the Group CFO and Finance teams to ensure seamless integration of local financial activities, reporting, treasury, and planning processes within the Group Finance framework.
You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.
What we're looking for
We are seeking a proven leader with a distinguished track record of success in driving strategic initiatives and achieving significant business growth within relevant sectors.
You will lead by example, combining ambition with purpose, drive impactful results and cultivate ownership and continuous improvement in our dynamic environment.
Executive Experience: At least 8 years of leadership in financial roles at a primary EU financial hub or within Luxembourg-regulated payment institutions, EMIs, or banks.
Compliance & Regulatory Mastery: Deep knowledge of CRR/CRD directives, CSSF requirements, Luxembourgish accounting (Lux GAAP/IFRS), and safeguarding standards.
Regulatory Eligibility: Candidates must be qualified to meet the CSSF's "fit-and-proper" criteria necessary for official designation as an authorized director or manager
Technical Core Competencies: Proven track record across treasury management, financial control, statutory and regulatory reporting, audit management, capital and liquidity management, and finance operations within regulated financial services environments. Strong understanding of Group consolidation processes, financial governance frameworks, and interaction with auditors, regulators, and supervisory authorities
Language capabilities: Complete fluency in English
We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.
Why this is your place
This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact is met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.
Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.
Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant, and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding.
Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.
Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

About us
Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance .
That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.
What you'll be doing
As CFO for our Luxembourg-regulated entity, you will be primarily responsible for maintaining the financial integrity, regulatory compliance, and fiscal oversight of Satispay's European hub. Acting as a regulator-approved key executive, your role involves aligning ambitious group-wide corporate goals with the demands of banking compliance, managing the local balance sheet, and safeguarding the entity's capital adequacy.
You will lead the entity's scalable Finance function, including statutory reporting, financial control, audit coordination, finance operations, and integration with the Group Finance organisation to support Satispay's growth and regulatory evolution.
Here's what that looks like in practice:
Reporting & Compliance: Take full accountability for the preparation and delivery of local statutory accounts, regulatory filings, and financial information required for Group consolidation, ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, compliance, and timeliness. Ensure adherence to Lux GAAP/IFRS, applicable regulatory requirements, and Group reporting policies.
Financial Strategy & Liquidity: Oversee the management of liquidity risks and the protection of client funds as per e-money statutes, while implementing effective yield-enhancement tactics for surplus liquidity. Lead treasury activities across the Luxembourg entity, including cash management, cash forecasting, and coordination with the Treasury team.
Risk Management: Track and uphold institutional capital benchmarks, establishing proactive detection mechanisms for market and liquidity exposures. Partner closely with the Chief Risk Officer and other control functions to ensure effective oversight of financial risks, including liquidity, capital, and balance sheet-related risks.
Stakeholder Representation: Act as Satispay's primary financial representative to regulatory bodies, tax offices, and external auditors, ensuring the successful execution of annual audits.
Financial Control & Performance Reporting: Oversee the Financial Control and Controlling functions, ensuring accurate month-end reporting, balance sheet integrity, and timely management information for local and Group stakeholders. Provide financial analysis and insights to support strategic decision-making and business performance monitoring.
Finance Operations: Ensure efficient and scalable Finance Operations processes, including reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end close activities. Establish and maintain a strong financial control environment across all operational finance processes.
Intercompany Integration: Work closely with the Group CFO and Finance teams to ensure seamless integration of local financial activities, reporting, treasury, and planning processes within the Group Finance framework.
You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.
What we're looking for
We are seeking a proven leader with a distinguished track record of success in driving strategic initiatives and achieving significant business growth within relevant sectors.
You will lead by example, combining ambition with purpose, drive impactful results and cultivate ownership and continuous improvement in our dynamic environment.
Executive Experience: At least 8 years of leadership in financial roles at a primary EU financial hub or within Luxembourg-regulated payment institutions, EMIs, or banks.
Compliance & Regulatory Mastery : Deep knowledge of CRR/CRD directives, CSSF requirements, Luxembourgish accounting (Lux GAAP/IFRS), and safeguarding standards.
Regulatory Eligibility: Candidates must be qualified to meet the CSSF's "fit-and-proper" criteria necessary for official designation as an authorized director or manager
Technical Core Competencies: Proven track record across treasury management, financial control, statutory and regulatory reporting, audit management, capital and liquidity management, and finance operations within regulated financial services environments. Strong understanding of Group consolidation processes, financial governance frameworks, and interaction with auditors, regulators, and supervisory authorities
Language capabilities: Complete fluency in English
We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.
Why this is your place
This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact is met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.
Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.
Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant, and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding.
Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.
Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

About us
Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.
That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. What you'll be doing
As our FinCrime AML/CTF Manager, you'll lead, grow, and manage our 1st line AML/CTF operations team, translating compliance policies into smooth, actionable risk management processes across the entire customer lifecycle.
Here's what that looks like in practice:
Customer Risk Management - Owning and maintaining the Customer Risk Assessment Frameworks, ensuring risk scoring and categorisation accurately reflect financial crime realities.
Lifecycle & Periodic Reviews - Leading periodic and event-driven reviews across the customer portfolio to dynamically reassess customer risk categorisations.
Oversight of Due Diligence Activities - Overseeing onboarding and ongoing monitoring activities executed by KYC and KYB teams, aligning internal controls with regulatory expectations.
Product Requirements & UX Optimisation - Partnering closely with Product teams to define actionable onboarding requirements that balance regulatory compliance with a frictionless user experience.
Surveillance & Detection Management - Overseeing end-to-end transaction monitoring for all AML/CTF typologies, including timely assessments, escalations, and scenario calibrations.
Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management - Mentoring and scaling a team of AML/CTF analysts, driving operational excellence, and regularly reporting risk metrics to senior management.
Compliance Translation - Acting as the primary liaison to the 2nd Line Compliance team, proactively translating regulatory updates into scalable operational workflows.
Reporting to the FIU - Serving as the final 1st line approver for Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) and Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs).
Audit & Regulatory Liaison - Preparing operational documentation and data for internal audits, external regulatory reviews, and inquiries from competent authorities.
Who we're looking for
This role needs someone equipped with strong leadership, deep regulatory mastery, and an operational mindset to protect our ecosystem against financial crime.
Experience - 6+ years in AML/CTF operations within Fintech, digital banking, or payment processing environments, with 2+ years of experience leading and managing dedicated teams.
Regulatory Knowledge - Profound understanding of EU AML Directives and FATF recommendations, with strong knowledge of Luxembourg regulatory requirements (knowledge of Italian regulations is a plus).
Certifications - Professional certification such as CAMS, ICA, or equivalent is highly expected.
Operational Framework Mastery - Proven track record managing transaction monitoring systems, reviewing/approving SARs/STRs, and designing practical customer risk-rating frameworks.
Stakeholder & Communication Skills - Exceptional ability to negotiate, collaborate across functions, and liaise seamlessly with 2nd line compliance teams.
Data-Driven Leadership - Strong analytical mindset capable of leveraging KPIs and data tools (such as HEX, SQL, or Splunk) to optimize operational queues and assess resource needs.
Change Management Mindset - Agility to lead teams through hyper-growth, shifting regulations, and tech upgrades while maintaining high morale and performance.
Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives. By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need.
What you'll be doing
As our Product Lead – Business & Merchant Domain, you’ll drive the evolution of our Business ecosystem and the products supporting the financial needs of companies. In this role, you will lead a team of business domain PMs while remaining directly hands-on with execution. This position requires a rare blend of product delivery, strategic leadership, and a powerful growth mindset to thrive in complexity, raise quality benchmarks, and continuously build product experiences that drive commercial success.
Here's what your day-to-day will look like:
Product Leadership & Execution – Own the end-to-end product lifecycle. Define the roadmap, design frictionless experiences, and deliver high-impact features.
Strategic Coordination – Mentor and coordinate Product Managers, ensuring cross-team collaboration, alignment, and a unified product vision.
Drive Commercial Growth & Engagement – Apply a strong growth mindset to design solutions that reactivate dormant merchants, increase feature adoption, boost upselling, and optimize conversion funnels.
Business & Customer Understanding – Develop a deep understanding of businesses' financial needs, market dynamics and competitive landscape, translating customer and market insights into product opportunities.
User-Centricity – Put merchants first by obsessing over user feedback, conducting continuous shadowing, and transforming pain points into seamless opportunities.
Data-Driven Decision Making – Define, track, and analyze key product metrics to validate hypotheses, measure impact, and relentlessly optimize funnel performance.
What We Are Looking For
We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in!
Does this sound like you?
B2B Product Management – 5+ years of experience in B2B Product Management, preferably within Business Banking, Fintech, Payments, Financial Services, B2B SaaS, or high-growth tech environments.
Financial Services Experience - Experience building or scaling products in banking, fintech or other financial services environments is a strong plus.
Leadership & Complexity Management – Experience managing people or leading highly complex, multi-stakeholder projects across organizational and technical boundaries.
Commercial Acumen / Growth Mindset – A strong business sense with an understanding of how to leverage product experiences to drive monetization, acquisition, and merchant engagement.
Obsession with Detail – High standards with a sharp eye for UX/UI details, copy, and operational excellence to constantly raise the bar.
Analytical Power – Deeply data-driven mindset with experience using advanced data platforms to track metrics, optimize funnels, and turn raw data into actionable strategic growth insights.
AI-Empowered Product Management – Strong AI fluency with the ability to integrate AI tools into daily workflows to accelerate product operations, research synthesis, and roadmap structuring.
